arabic_source:
٦٩١١ — عن أبي هريرة قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( لا يزني الزاني حين يزني وهو مؤمن، ولا يسرق حين يسرق وهو مؤمن، ولا يشرب الخمر حين يشربها وهو مؤمن)).
 متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٥٥٧٨) ومسلم (٥٧).

Agreed upon. Narrated by al-Bukhari (5578) and Muslim (57).

٦٩١٢ — عن أبي هريرة قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( لا ينظرُ اللهُ يومَ القيامة إلى الشيخ الزاني، ولا إلى العجوز الزانية )).
 حسن: رواه الطبراني في الأوسط - مجمع البحرين (٢٤٤٨).

٦٩١٣ — عن عبد اللّٰه بن عمر قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( المسلم أخو المسلم، لا يظلمه، ولا يسلمه، من كان في حاجة أخيه كان اللّٰه في حاجته، ومن فرّج عن مسلم كربة، فرّج اللّٰه عنه بها كربةً من كرب يوم القيامة، ومن ستر مسلماً ستره اللّٰه يوم القيامة)).
 متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٢٤٤٢) ومسلم (٢٥٨٠).

6913 — Abdullah ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim. He does not oppress him nor abandon him. Whoever fulfills the need of his brother, Allah will fulfill his need. Whoever relieves a Muslim of a hardship, Allah will relieve him of a hardship from the hardships of the Day of Resurrection. Whoever conceals a Muslim, Allah will conceal him on the Day of Resurrection.”
Agreed upon. Narrated by al-Bukhari (2442) and Muslim (2580).

٦٩١٤ — عن أبي هريرة قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( من نفّس عن مؤمن كربة من كرب الدنيا نفّس اللّٰه عنه كربة من كرب يوم القيامة. ومن يسّر على معسر يسّر اللّٰه عليه في الدنيا والآخرة، ومن ستر مسلماً ستره اللّٰه في الدنيا والآخرة، والله في عون العبد ما كان العبد في عون أخيه)).
 صحيح: رواه مسلم (٢٦٩٩).

6914 — Abu Hurairah reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever relieves a believer of a hardship from the hardships of this world, Allah will relieve him of a hardship from the hardships of the Day of Resurrection. Whoever makes things easy for one in difficulty, Allah will make things easy for him in this world and the Hereafter. Whoever conceals a Muslim, Allah will conceal him in this world and the Hereafter. Allah continues to aid the servant so long as the servant aids his brother.”
Sahih. Narrated by Muslim (2699).

٦٩١٥ — عن ابن عمر أن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ قام بعد أن رجم الأسلمي فقال: (( اجتنبوا هذه القاذورة التي نهى اللّٰه عنها، فمن ألمَّ فليستتر بستر الله، وليتب إلى الله، فإنه من يبد لنا صفحته نُقِمْ عليه كتاب اللّٰه عز وجل)).
 صحيح: رواه الحاكم (٢٤٤/٤) والبيهقي (٣٣٠/٨).

6915 — Ibn Umar reported that after the Prophet ﷺ carried out the stoning of the man from Aslam, he stood and said: “Avoid these filthy acts which Allah has forbidden. Whoever falls into any of them should conceal himself with the concealment of Allah and repent to Allah, for whoever exposes himself to us, we will apply the Book of Allah upon him.”
Sahih. Narrated by al-Hakim (4/244) and al-Bayhaqi (8/330).

٦٩١٦ — عن عبادة بن الصامت قال: كنا مع رسول اللّٰه ﷺ في مجلس فقال: (( تبايعوني على أن لا تشركوا بالله شيئا، ولا تزنوا، ولا تسرقوا، ولا تقتلوا النفس التي حرم اللّه إلا بالحق. فمن وفّى منكم فأجره على الله، ومن أصاب شيئا من ذلك فعوقبَ به، فهو كفارة له، ومن أصاب شيئا من ذلك، فستر اللّٰه عليه فأمره إلى الله، إن شاء عفا عنه، وإن شاء عذّبه)).
 متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٧٨٤) ومسلم (٤١/١٧٠٩). واللفظ لمسلم.

6916 — Ubadah ibn al-Samit reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a gathering and he said: “Pledge allegiance to me that you will not associate anything with Allah, nor commit adultery, nor steal, nor kill the soul that Allah has forbidden except with right. Whoever among you fulfills this, his reward is with Allah. Whoever commits any of these acts and is punished for it, then it is an expiation for him. Whoever commits any of these acts and Allah conceals him, then his matter is with Allah; if He wills He may forgive him, and if He wills He may punish him.”
Agreed upon. Narrated by al-Bukhari (6784) and Muslim (1709/41). The wording is from Muslim.

6916 — Ubadah ibn al-Samit reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a gathering and he said: “Pledge allegiance to me that you will not associate anything with Allah, nor commit adultery, nor steal, nor kill the soul that Allah has forbidden except with right. Whoever among you fulfills this, his reward is with Allah. Whoever commits any of these acts and is punished for it, then it is an expiation for him. Whoever commits any of these acts and Allah conceals him, then his matter is with Allah; if He wills He may forgive him, and if He wills He may punish him.”
Agreed upon. Narrated by al-Bukhari (6784) and Muslim (1709/41). The wording is from Muslim.

arabic_source:
٦٩١٧ — عن عبادة بن الصامت قال: أخذ علينا رسول اللّٰه ﷺ كما أخذ على النساء: أن لا نشرك بالله شيئا، ولا نسرق، ولا نزني، ولا نقتل أولادنا، ولا يعضه بعضنا بعضا. (( فمن وفى منكم فأجره على الله، ومن أتى منكم حداً فأقيم عليه فهو كفارته، ومن ستره اللّٰه عليه فأمره إلى الله، إن شاء عذّبه وإن شاء غفر له )).
 صحيح: رواه مسلم (٤٣/١٧٠٩).
وقوله: (( ولا يعضه )) معناه لا يرميه بالعضيهة وهي البهتان.
 هذا القيد يبين المقصود من الحديث بأنه لا يشمل الشرك بالله الذي ذكر في أول الحديث لأن اللّٰه قال:
 ( إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ أَن يُشْرَكَ بِهِ ) [النساء: ٤٨ ]
 فإن الشرك ليس تحت المشيئة. فإذا ارتد المسلم، وصار مشركا فقتل على ارتداده فهذا القتل لا يكون كفارة له، إنما هو مخصوص بالمسلم الذي أتى بالحد من الزنا والسرقة والفرية والشرب وغيرها.

english_source:
6917 — Ubadah ibn al-Samit reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took a pledge from us just as he took a pledge from the women: that we would not associate anything with Allah, nor steal, nor commit adultery, nor kill our children, nor falsely accuse one another. “Whoever among you fulfills this, his reward is with Allah. Whoever commits an offense deserving a legal punishment and it is carried out upon him, then it is an expiation for him. Whoever Allah conceals, then his matter is with Allah; if He wills He may punish him, and if He wills He may forgive him.”
Sahih. Narrated by Muslim (1709/43).
His statement: “nor falsely accuse one another” means not to accuse someone with slander and false allegations.
This condition clarifies that the hadith does not include associating partners with Allah mentioned at the beginning of the narration, because Allah said:
“Indeed, Allah does not forgive associating partners with Him.” [Surah al-Nisa: 48]
Polytheism is therefore not subject to divine choice in this context. If a Muslim apostatizes and becomes a polytheist and is killed for apostasy, that execution is not an expiation for him. Rather, this applies specifically to a Muslim who commits offenses such as adultery, theft, false accusation, drinking intoxicants, and similar sins for which legal punishments are prescribed.

٦٩١٨ — عن علي بن أبي طالب، عن النبي ﷺ قال: (( من أصاب حدّاً فعُجّلت عقوبتُه في الدنيا، فالله أعدل من أن يثنّى على عبده العقوبة في الآخرة، ومن أصاب حدّاً فستره اللّٰه عليه، وعفا عنه فالله أكرم من أن يعود في شيء قد عفا عنه)).
 حسن: رواه الترمذي (٢٦٢٦) وابن ماجه (٢٦٠٤) وأحمد (٧٧٥) والدار قطني (٢١٥/٣).

6918 — Ali ibn Abi Talib reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever commits an offense deserving a legal punishment and its punishment is hastened for him in this world, then Allah is too just to punish His servant twice in the Hereafter. And whoever commits an offense deserving a legal punishment and Allah conceals him and pardons him, then Allah is too generous to return to something He has already pardoned.”
Hasan. Narrated by al-Tirmidhi (2626), Ibn Majah (2604), Ahmad (775), and al-Daraqutni (3/215).

6919 — Ubadah ibn al-Samit reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Establish the limits set by Allah upon both the near and the distant, and do not let the blame of any blamer prevent you regarding Allah.”
Hasan. Narrated by Ibn Majah (2540) and Abdullah ibn Ahmad in his Zawa’id (22795).

٦٩٢٠ — عن عائشة زوج النبي ﷺ أنها قالت: ما خُيِّر رسول اللّٰه ﷺ في أمرين قط إلا أخذ أيسرهما، ما لم يكن إثماً، فإن كان إثماً كان أبعد الناس منه، وما انتقم رسول اللّٰه ﷺ لنفسه، إلا أن تُنتهك حرمة الله، فينتقم لله بها.
 متفق عليه: رواه مالك (٢)، والبخاري (٣٥٦٠)، ومسلم (٢٣٢٧).

6920 — Aishah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, said: “Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was given a choice between two matters, he would choose the easier of the two so long as it was not sinful. But if it was sinful, he was the furthest of people from it. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never took revenge for himself, except when the sacred limits of Allah were violated, in which case he would seek justice for the sake of Allah.”
Agreed upon. Narrated by Malik (2), al-Bukhari (3560), and Muslim (2327).

But if it was sinful, he was the furthest of people from it. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never took revenge for himself, except when the sacred limits of Allah were violated, in which case he would seek justice for the sake of Allah.”

6921 — Aishah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, reported that the Quraysh were deeply concerned about the case of the woman who stole during the time of the Prophet ﷺ in the Conquest of Makkah.

Usamah said: “Ask forgiveness for me, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ.”
Then in the evening, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood and delivered a sermon. He praised Allah as He deserves to be praised, then said:
“What destroyed those before you was that when a noble person among them stole, they left him alone, but when a weak person stole, they carried out the punishment upon him. By the One in whose hand is my soul, if Fatimah the daughter of Muhammad were to steal, I would cut off her hand.”
Then he ordered that the hand of the woman who stole be cut off.
Yunus said: Ibn Shihab said: Urwah said: Aishah said: “Her repentance afterward was excellent. She later married, and after that she would come to me, and I would present her needs to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.”

٦٩٢٢ — عن بهز بن حكيم بن معاوية، عن أبيه، عن جده قال: أخذ النبي ﷺ ناساً من قومي في تهمة، فحبسهم، فجاء رجل من قومي إلى النبي ﷺ وهو يخطب فقال: يا محمد، علام تحبس جيرتي؟ فصمت النبي ﷺ فقال: إن ناساً ليقولون: إنك تنهى عن الشر وتستخلي به، فقال النبي ﷺ: (( ما يقول؟ )) قال: فجعلت أعرّض بينهما بالكلام مخافة أن يسمعها، فيدعو على قومي دعوة لا يُفلحون بعدها أبداً. فلم يزل النبي ﷺ به حتى فهمها. فقال:
 (( قد قالوها — أو قائلها منهم؟ والله لو فعلتُ لكان عليّ وما كان عليهم، خلُّوا له عن جيرانه )).
 حسن: رواه أحمد (٢٠٠١٩) وعبد الرزاق في مصنفه (١٨٨٩١)، وأبو داود (٣٦٣٠) والترمذي (١٤١٧) وحسّنه.

6922 — Bahz ibn Hakim narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that the Prophet ﷺ detained some people from his tribe on suspicion.
Then a man from his tribe came to the Prophet ﷺ while he was delivering a sermon and said: “O Muhammad, why are you detaining my neighbors?”
The Prophet ﷺ remained silent. Then the man said: “Some people claim that you forbid wrongdoing while practicing it secretly.”
The Prophet ﷺ said: “What is he saying?”
The narrator said: “I began speaking indirectly between them, fearing that he might hear it and supplicate against my people with a supplication after which they would never prosper.”
But the Prophet ﷺ continued until he understood what had been said. Then he said:
“They have indeed said it — or one of them has said it. By Allah, if I had done that, then the blame would be upon me and not upon them. Release his neighbors for him.”
Hasan. Narrated by Ahmad (20019), Abd al-Razzaq in al-Musannaf (18891), Abu Dawud (3630), and al-Tirmidhi (1417), who graded it Hasan.

٦٩٢٣ — عن النعمان بن بشير أنه رفع إليه نفر من الكلاعيين أن حاكة سرقوا متاعاً لهم، حبسهم أياماً، ثم خلى سبيلهم. فأتوه فقالوا: خليت سبيل هؤلاء بلا امتحان ولا ضرب. فقال النعمان: ما شئتم، إن شئتم أضربهم فإن أخرج اللّٰه متاعكم فذاك، وإلا أخذت من ظهوركم مثله.
 قالوا: هذا حكمك؟ قال: هذا حكم اللّٰه عز وجل ورسوله ﷺ.
 حسن: رواه النسائي (٤٨٧٤) وأبو داود (٤٣٨٢).

6923 — It was reported from al-Nu‘man ibn Bashir that some people from the tribe of Kila‘ brought a complaint to him that some weavers had stolen their belongings.
He detained them for several days and then released them. They came back and said: “You released them without interrogation or beating.”
Al-Nu‘man said: “As you wish. If you want, I can beat them. If Allah causes your property to appear, then that is fine. Otherwise, I will take the equivalent from your backs.”
They said: “Is this your judgment?”
He replied: “This is the judgment of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and His Messenger ﷺ.”
Hasan. Narrated by al-Nasa’i (4874) and Abu Dawud (4382).

٦٩٢٣ — عن النعمان بن بشير أنه رفع إليه نفر من الكلاعيين أن حاكة سرقوا متاعاً لهم، حبسهم أياماً، ثم خلى سبيلهم. فأتوه فقالوا: خليت سبيل هؤلاء بلا امتحان ولا ضرب. فقال النعمان: ما شئتم، إن شئتم أضربهم فإن أخرج اللّٰه متاعكم فذاك، وإلا أخذت من ظهوركم مثله.

٦٩٢٤ — عن عطية القرظي قال:
عُرضنا على رسول اللّٰه ﷺ يوم قريظة، فكان من أنبت قُتل، ومن لم ينبت خُلِّي سبيله، فكنت فيمن لم ينبت فخُلِّي سبيلي.
وفي رواية:
«فَكَشَفُوا عَانَتِي، فَوَجَدُوهَا لَمْ تَنْبُتْ، فَجَعَلُونِي فِي السَّبْيِ».
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٠٤)، والترمذي (١٥٨٤)، وابن ماجه (٢٥٤١)، والنسائي (٤٩٨١)، وصححه ابن حبان (٤٧٨٠).

6924 — ʿAṭiyyah al-Quraẓī reported:
We were presented before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of Qurayẓah. Whoever had grown pubic hair was killed, and whoever had not grown it was released. I was among those who had not grown it, so I was released.
In another narration:
“They examined my pubic area and found that the hair had not yet grown, so they placed me among the captives.”
Good: Narrated by Abū Dāwūd (4404), al-Tirmidhī (1584), Ibn Mājah (2541), and al-Nasāʾī (4981), and authenticated by Ibn Ḥibbān (4780).

٦٩٢٥ — عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي ﷺ قال: (( إذا ضرب أحدكم فليتق الوجه )).
 حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٩٣)، ورواه أحمد (٧٣٢٣) وزاد فيه: (( فإن اللّٰه خلق آدم على صورته )).

٦٩٢٦ — عن عبد الله بن مسعود قال: سألت النبي ﷺ: أي الذنب أعظم عند الله؟ قال: (( أن تجعل لله نداً وهو خلقك )). قلت: إن ذلك لعظيم. قلت: ثم أي؟ قال: (( وأن تقتل ولدك تخاف أن يطعم معك )). قلت: ثم أي؟ قال: (( أن تزاني حليلة جارك )).
 متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٤٤٧٧) ومسلم (٨٦).

english_source:
6926 — Abdullah ibn Mas‘ud said: I asked the Prophet ﷺ, “Which sin is greatest before Allah?” He said: “That you set up a rival to Allah while He created you.” I said: “Indeed that is grave.” I said: “Then what?” He said: “That you kill your child fearing that he will eat with you.” I said: “Then what?” He said: “That you commit adultery with your neighbor’s wife.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (4477) and Muslim (86).

٦٩٢٧ — عن سمرة بن جندب قال: كان رسول اللّٰه ﷺ مما يكثر أن يقول لأصحابه: (( هل رأى أحد منكم من رؤيا؟ )) قال: فيقص عليه من شاء اللّٰه أن يقص، وإنه قال ذات غداة: (( إنه أتاني الليلة آتيان وإنهما ابتعثاني، وإنهما قالا لي: انطلق، وإني انطلقت معهما.. )) فذكر الحديث بطوله.
وفيه: (( فانطلقنا فأتينا على مثل التنور - قال: وأحسب أنه كان يقول: - فإذا فيه لَغط وأصوات.
 قال: فاطلعنا فيه فإذا فيه رجال ونساء عُراة، وإذا هم يأتيهم لهب من أسفل منهم، فإذا أتاهم ذلك اللهب ضَوضَوا، قال: قلت لهما: ما هؤلاء؟ قال: قالا لي: انطلق انطلق.. )) ثم أخبراه بذلك فقالا:
 (( وأما الرجال والنساء العراة الذين في مثل بناء التنور فهم الزناة والزواني)).
صحيح: رواه البخاري (٧٠٤٧)، ومسلم (٢٣/٢٢٧٥).

6927 — Samurah ibn Jundub said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would often say to his companions: “Has any one of you seen a dream?” Then whoever Allah willed would relate a dream to him. One morning he said: “Last night two visitors came to me and woke me up, and they said to me: ‘Come.’ So I went with them…” Then he mentioned the lengthy narration.
In it is: “We came to something like an oven.” He said: “I think he used to say: inside it was noise and voices. We looked inside and found naked men and women. Flames would come to them from beneath them, and when the flames reached them they cried out loudly. I said to them: ‘Who are these?’ They said to me: ‘Go on, go on…’”
Then they later informed him: “As for the naked men and women who were in the structure resembling an oven, they are the male and female adulterers.”
Authentic: Narrated by al-Bukhari (7047) and Muslim (2275).

6928 — Abu Umamah narrated that a young man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, permit me to commit adultery.”
The people turned toward him and rebuked him, saying: “Stop! Stop!” But the Prophet ﷺ said: “Bring him close.” So he came near and sat down.
He said: “Would you like it for your mother?”
 He replied: “No, by Allah, may Allah make me your ransom.”
 He said: “Nor do people like it for their mothers.”
He said: “Would you like it for your daughter?”
 He replied: “No, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, may Allah make me your ransom.”
 He said: “Nor do people like it for their daughters.”
He said: “Would you like it for your sister?”
 He replied: “No, by Allah, may Allah make me your ransom.”
 He said: “Nor do people like it for their sisters.”
He said: “Would you like it for your paternal aunt?”
 He replied: “No, by Allah, may Allah make me your ransom.”
 He said: “Nor do people like it for their paternal aunts.”
He said: “Would you like it for your maternal aunt?”
 He replied: “No, by Allah, may Allah make me your ransom.”
 He said: “Nor do people like it for their maternal aunts.”
Then he placed his hand upon him and said: “O Allah, forgive his sin, purify his heart, and guard his chastity.”
After that, the young man never turned toward anything sinful.
Sahih: Narrated by Ahmad (22211) and al-Tabarani (7679).

٦٩٢٩ — عن أبي هريرة عن النبي ﷺ قال: (( سبعة يظلهم اللّٰه يوم القيامة في ظله، يوم لا ظل إلا ظله: إمام عادل، وشاب نشأ في عبادة الله، ورجل ذكر اللّٰه في خلاء ففاضت عيناه، ورجل قلبه معلق في المسجد، ورجلان تحابا في الله، ورجل دعته امرأة ذات منصب وجمال إلى نفسها فقال: إني أخاف الله، ورجل تصدق بصدقة فأخفاها حتى لا تعلم شماله ما صنعت يمينه)).
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٨٠٦) ومسلم (١٠٣١).

6929 — Abu Hurayrah narrated from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “Seven will be shaded by Allah on the Day when there will be no shade except His shade: a just ruler; a young man raised in the worship of Allah; a man who remembers Allah in solitude and his eyes overflow with tears; a man whose heart is attached to the mosque; two men who love one another for the sake of Allah; a man who is invited by a woman of status and beauty to herself, but he says: ‘Indeed, I fear Allah’; and a man who gives charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand has spent.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6806) and Muslim (1031).

٦٩٣٠ — عن عبد اللّٰه بن عمر أنه قال: جاءت اليهود إلى رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فذكروا له أن رجلاً منهم وامرأة زنيا، فقال لهم رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( ما تجدون في التوراة في شأن الرجم؟ )) فقالوا: نفضحهم ويُجلدون. فقال عبد اللّٰه بن سلام: كذبتم، إن فيها الرجم. فأتوا بالتوراة فنشروها، فوضع أحدهم يده على آية الرجم، ثم قرأ ما قبلها وما بعدها. فقال عبد اللّٰه بن سلام: ارفع يدك. فرفع يده فإذا فيها آية الرجم. فقالوا: صدق يا محمد، فيها آية الرجم. فأمر بهما رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فرُجما. فقال عبد اللّٰه بن عمر: فرأيت الرجل يحني على المرأة يقيها الحجارة.
متفق عليه: رواه مالك (١) و البخاري (٦٨٤١)، ومسلم (٢٦:١٦٩٩).

6930 — Abdullah ibn Umar said: The Jews came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and informed him that a man and a woman among them had committed adultery. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: “What do you find in the Torah concerning stoning?”
They said: “We disgrace them and flog them.”
Abdullah ibn Salam said: “You have lied. It contains stoning.”
So they brought the Torah and spread it open. One of them placed his hand over the verse of stoning and read what came before it and after it. Abdullah ibn Salam said: “Lift your hand.” When he lifted it, the verse of stoning was there.
They said: “Muhammad has spoken the truth; the verse of stoning is indeed in it.”
So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered that they be stoned. Abdullah ibn Umar said: “I saw the man leaning over the woman, shielding her from the stones.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by Malik (1), al-Bukhari (6841), and Muslim (1699).

٦٩٣٠ — عن عبد اللّٰه بن عمر أنه قال: جاءت اليهود إلى رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فذكروا له أن رجلاً منهم وامرأة زنيا، فقال لهم رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( ما تجدون في التوراة في شأن الرجم؟ )) فقالوا: نفضحهم ويُجلدون. فقال عبد اللّٰه بن سلام: كذبتم، إن فيها الرجم. فأتوا بالتوراة فنشروها، فوضع أحدهم يده على آية الرجم، ثم قرأ ما قبلها وما بعدها. فقال عبد اللّٰه بن سلام: ارفع يدك. فرفع يده فإذا فيها آية الرجم. فقالوا: صدق يا محمد، فيها آية الرجم. فأمر بهما رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فرُجما. فقال عبد اللّٰه بن عمر: فرأيت الرجل يحني على المرأة يقيها الحجارة.
متفق عليه: رواه مالك (١) و البخاري (٦٨٤١)، ومسلم (٢٦:١٦٩٩).
6930 — Abdullah ibn Umar said: The Jews came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and informed him that a man and a woman among them had committed adultery. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: “What do you find in the Torah concerning stoning?”
They said: “We disgrace them and flog them.”
Abdullah ibn Salam said: “You have lied. It contains stoning.”
So they brought the Torah and spread it open. One of them placed his hand over the verse of stoning and read what came before it and after it. Abdullah ibn Salam said: “Lift your hand.” When he lifted it, the verse of stoning was there.
They said: “Muhammad has spoken the truth; the verse of stoning is indeed in it.”
So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered that they be stoned. Abdullah ibn Umar said: “I saw the man leaning over the woman, shielding her from the stones.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by Malik (1), al-Bukhari (6841), and Muslim (1699).

٦٩٣١ — عن ابن عمر قال: أتى نفر من اليهود فدعوا رسول اللّٰه ﷺ إلى القُفّ، فأتاهم في بيت المدراس. فقالوا: يا أبا القاسم، إن رجلاً منا زنى بامرأة فاحكم. فوضعوا لرسول اللّٰه ﷺ وسادة فجلس عليها، ثم قال: (( ائتوني بالتوراة )). فأُتي بها، فنزع الوسادة من تحته ووضع التوراة عليها، ثم قال: (( آمنت بك وبمن أنزلك )). ثم قال: (( ائتوني بأعلمكم )). فأُتي بفتى شاب، ثم ذكر قصة الرجم نحو حديث مالك عن نافع.
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٤٩).

6931 — Ibn Umar said: A group of Jews came and invited the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to al-Quff. He came to them in the study house. They said: “O Abu al-Qasim, a man among us committed adultery with a woman, so judge between them.”
They placed a cushion for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he sat upon it. Then he said: “Bring me the Torah.” When it was brought, he removed the cushion from beneath himself and placed the Torah upon it. Then he said: “I believe in you and in the One who revealed you.”
Then he said: “Bring me your most knowledgeable person.” So a young scholar was brought. Then he mentioned the story of stoning similar to the narration of Malik from Nafi‘.
Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4449).

٦٩٣٢ — عن البراء بن عازب قال: مرّ على النبي ﷺ بيهودي محمماً مجلوداً، فدعاهم فقال:
 (( هكذا تجدون حد الزاني في كتابكم؟ )) قالوا: نعم. فدعا رجلا من علمائهم. فقال:
 (( أنشدُك بالله الذي أنزل التوراة على موسى! أهكذا تجدون حد الزاني في كتابكم؟ ))
 قال: لا. ولولا أنك نشدتني بهذا لم أخبرك. نجده الرجم. ولكنه كثر في أشرافنا. فكنا، إذا أخذنا الشريف تركناه. وإذا أخذنا الضعيف أقمنا عليه الحد، قلنا: تعالوا فلنجتمع على شيء نقيمه على الشريف والوضيع. فجعلنا التحميم والجلد مكان الرجم. فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
 (( اللهم! إني أول من أحيا أمرك إذا أماتوه )) فأمر به فرجم.
فأنزل اللّٰه عز وجل:
 (يَاأَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ لَا يَحْزُنكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ) [المائدة: ٤١] إلى قوله:
 (إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هَذَا فَخُذُوهُ) [المائدة: ٤١]
 يقول: ائتوا محمداً ﷺ فإن أمركم بالتحميم والجلد فخذوه، وإن أفتاكم بالرجم فاحذروا.
فأنزل اللّٰه تعالى:
 (وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ) [المائدة: ٤٤]
 (وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ) [المائدة: ٤٥]
 (وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ) [المائدة: ٤٧]
 في الكفار كلها.
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٧٠٠).

6932 — Al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib said: A Jewish man who had been blackened and flogged was brought past the Prophet ﷺ. He called them and said:
“Is this how you find the punishment of the adulterer in your Book?”
They said: “Yes.”
So he called one of their scholars and said:
“I adjure you by Allah who revealed the Torah to Musa: is this how you find the punishment of the adulterer in your Book?”
He replied: “No. Had you not adjured me by this, I would not have informed you. We find that it is stoning. But adultery became widespread among our nobles, so when we caught a noble person we left him, and when we caught a weak person we carried out the punishment on him. So we said: let us agree upon something that we can apply equally to both the noble and the weak. Thus we replaced stoning with blackening the face and flogging.”
So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“O Allah, I am the first to revive Your command after they had caused it to die.”
Then he ordered that the man be stoned.
Then Allah the Mighty and Majestic revealed:
“O Messenger, do not be grieved by those who hasten into disbelief…” [Surah al-Ma’idah: 41] up to His saying:
“If you are given this, then take it.” [Surah al-Ma’idah: 41]
Meaning: “Go to Muhammad ﷺ; if he gives you the ruling of blackening and flogging, then accept it, but if he gives you the ruling of stoning, then beware.”
Then Allah revealed:
“And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed — then they are the disbelievers.” [Surah al-Ma’idah: 44]
“And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed — then they are the wrongdoers.” [Surah al-Ma’idah: 45]
“And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed — then they are the defiantly disobedient.” [Surah al-Ma’idah: 47]
All concerning the disbelievers.
Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (1700).

 (وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ) [المائدة: ٤٤]
 (وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ) [المائدة: ٤٥]
 (وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ) [المائدة: ٤٧]
 في الكفار كلها.
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٧٠٠).
6932 — Al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib said: A Jewish man who had been blackened and flogged was brought past the Prophet ﷺ. He called them and said:
“Is this how you find the punishment of the adulterer in your Book?”
They said: “Yes.”
So he called one of their scholars and said:
“I adjure you by Allah who revealed the Torah to Musa: is this how you find the punishment of the adulterer in your Book?”
He replied: “No. Had you not adjured me by this, I would not have informed you. We find that it is stoning. But adultery became widespread among our nobles, so when we caught a noble person we left him, and when we caught a weak person we carried out the punishment on him. So we said: let us agree upon something that we can apply equally to both the noble and the weak. Thus we replaced stoning with blackening the face and flogging.”
So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“O Allah, I am the first to revive Your command after they had caused it to die.”
Then he ordered that the man be stoned.
Then Allah the Mighty and Majestic revealed:
“O Messenger, do not be grieved by those who hasten into disbelief…” [Surah al-Ma’idah: 41] up to His saying:
“If you are given this, then take it.” [Surah al-Ma’idah: 41]
Meaning: “Go to Muhammad ﷺ; if he gives you the ruling of blackening and flogging, then accept it, but if he gives you the ruling of stoning, then beware.”
Then Allah revealed:
“And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed — then they are the disbelievers.” [Surah al-Ma’idah: 44]
“And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed — then they are the wrongdoers.” [Surah al-Ma’idah: 45]
“And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed — then they are the defiantly disobedient.” [Surah al-Ma’idah: 47]
All concerning the disbelievers.
Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (1700).

I said: “Was that after the revelation of Surah al-Nur or before it?”
He replied: “I do not know.”
Sahih: Narrated by Ahmad (19126) and Ibn Hibban (4433).

٦٩٣٦ — عن ابن عباس قال: أمر رسول اللّٰه ﷺ برجم اليهودي واليهودية عند باب مسجده، فلما وجد اليهودي مس الحجارة قام على صاحبته، فجنا عليها يقيها مس الحجارة، حتى قتلا جميعا، فكان مما صنع اللّٰه عز وجل لرسوله في تحقيق الزنا منهما.
حسن: رواه الإمام أحمد (٢٣٦٨)، والطبراني في الكبير (٤٠٣/١٠) والحاكم (٣٦٥/٤).

6936 — Ibn Abbas said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered the Jewish man and woman to be stoned at the door of his mosque. When the Jewish man felt the impact of the stones, he bent over his companion, shielding her from the stones until they both died. This was among the ways Allah the Mighty and Majestic made clear the reality of their adultery to His Messenger ﷺ.
Hasan: Narrated by Imam Ahmad (2368), al-Tabarani in al-Kabir (10/403), and al-Hakim (4/365).

٦٩٣٧ — عن ابن عباس أنه قال: سمعت عمر بن الخطاب يقول: الرجم في كتاب اللّٰه حق على من زنى من الرجال والنساء إذا أُحصن، إذا قامت البينة، أو كان الحبل، أو الاعتراف.

6937 — Ibn Abbas said: I heard Umar ibn al-Khattab say:
“Stoning is a true ruling in the Book of Allah upon married men and women who commit adultery, when proof is established, or pregnancy occurs, or there is confession.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by Malik (8), al-Bukhari (6830), and Muslim (1691).

٦٩٣٨ — عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ قَالَ: كَانَ ابْنُ الْعَاصِ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ يَكْتُبَانِ الْمَصَاحِفَ، فَمَرُّوا عَلَى هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ، فَقَالَ زَيْدٌ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللّٰه ﷺ يَقُولُ:
 (( الشَّيْخُ وَالشَّيْخَةُ إِذَا زَنَيَا فَارْجُمُوهُمَا الْبَتَّةَ ))
فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: لَمَّا أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللّٰه ﷺ فَقُلْتُ: أَكْتُبْنِيهَا.
قَالَ شُعْبَةُ: فَكَأَنَّهُ كَرِهَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: أَلَا تَرَى أَنَّ الشَّيْخَ إِذَا لَمْ يُحْصَنْ جُلِدَ، وَأَنَّ الشَّابَّ إِذَا زَنَى وَقَدْ أُحْصِنَ رُجِمَ.
صحيح: رواه أحمد (٢١٥٩٦).
فلعل قوله: “ الشيخ والشيخة إذا زنيا…” من وحي السنة، وليس من وحي القرآن.

6938 — Kathir ibn al-Salt said: Ibn al-‘As and Zayd ibn Thabit were writing copies of the Mushaf when they came across this verse. Zayd said: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
‘The elderly man and elderly woman, if they commit adultery, stone them completely.’”
Umar said: “When this was revealed, I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: ‘Let me write it down.’”
Shu‘bah said: “It was as though he disliked that.”
Then Umar said: “Do you not see that an old person, if unmarried, is flogged, while a young person, if married and commits adultery, is stoned?”
Sahih: Narrated by Ahmad (21596).
Perhaps the statement, “The elderly man and elderly woman, if they commit adultery…” was from revelation of the Sunnah and not from the recited Qur’an.

٦٩٣٨ — عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ قَالَ: كَانَ ابْنُ الْعَاصِ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ يَكْتُبَانِ الْمَصَاحِفَ، فَمَرُّوا عَلَى هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ، فَقَالَ زَيْدٌ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللّٰه ﷺ يَقُولُ:
 (( الشَّيْخُ وَالشَّيْخَةُ إِذَا زَنَيَا فَارْجُمُوهُمَا الْبَتَّةَ ))
فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: لَمَّا أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللّٰه ﷺ فَقُلْتُ: أَكْتُبْنِيهَا.
قَالَ شُعْبَةُ: فَكَأَنَّهُ كَرِهَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: أَلَا تَرَى أَنَّ الشَّيْخَ إِذَا لَمْ يُحْصَنْ جُلِدَ، وَأَنَّ الشَّابَّ إِذَا زَنَى وَقَدْ أُحْصِنَ رُجِمَ.

٦٩٣٩ — عن عبادة بن الصامت قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
 (( خذوا عني، خذوا عني، قد جعل اللّٰه لهن سبيلاً: البكر بالبكر جلد مائة ونفي سنة، والثيب بالثيب جلد مائة والرجم)).
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٢:١٦٩٠).
قوله: (( قد جعل اللّٰه لهن سبيلاً )): إشارة إلى قوله تعالى: ﴿فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ فِي الْبُيُوتِ حَتَّىٰ يَتَوَفَّاهُنَّ الْمَوْتُ أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًا﴾ [النساء: ١٥]

6939 — ‘Ubadah ibn al-Samit said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“Take from me, take from me. Allah has now made a way for them: the unmarried man with the unmarried woman — one hundred lashes and exile for one year; and the married man with the married woman — one hundred lashes and stoning.”
Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (1690).
His statement, “Allah has now made a way for them,” is a reference to the saying of Allah the Exalted:
“Confine them to houses until death takes them or Allah makes for them a way.” [Surah al-Nisa’: 15]

٦٩٤٠ — عن ابن عباس قال: ﴿وَاللَّاتِي يَأْتِينَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مِن نِّسَائِكُمْ فَاسْتَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةً مِّنكُمْ فَإِن شَهِدُوا فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ فِي الْبُيُوتِ حَتَّىٰ يَتَوَفَّاهُنَّ الْمَوْتُ أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًا﴾ [النساء: ١٥]
وذكر الرجل بعد المرأة، ثم جمعهما فقال: ﴿وَاللَّذَانِ يَأْتِيَانِهَا مِنكُمْ فَآذُوهُمَا فَإِن تَابَا وَأَصْلَحَا فَأَعْرِضُوا عَنْهُمَا﴾ [النساء: ١٦]
نسخ ذلك بآية الجلد فقال: ﴿الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَائِفَةٌ مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ [النور: ٢]
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٤١٣) والبيهقي (٢١٠/٨).

“And those among your women who commit immorality — call four witnesses against them from among you. If they testify, then confine them to houses until death takes them or Allah makes for them a way.” [Surah al-Nisa’: 15]

“The female adulterer and the male adulterer — flog each one of them with one hundred lashes, and let not pity for them overcome you in the religion of Allah, if you believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.” [Surah al-Nur: 2]

٦٩٤٣ — عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: رَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَسْلَمَ، وَرَجُلًا مِنَ الْيَهُودِ، وَامْرَأَتَهُ.

٦٩٤٤ — عن أبي هريرة قال:
أتى رجل من أسلم رسول اللّٰه ﷺ وهو في المسجد، فناداه فقال:
يا رسول الله ﷺ، إني زنيت.
فأعرض عنه حتى رد عليه أربع مرات.
فلما شهد على نفسه أربع شهادات، دعاه النبي ﷺ فقال:
«أَبِكَ جُنُونٌ؟»
قال: لا.
قال:
«فَهَلْ أَحْصَنْتَ؟»
قال: نعم.
فقال النبي ﷺ:
«اذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَارْجُمُوهُ».
قال ابن شهاب:
فأخبرني من سمع جابر بن عبد الله قال:
فكنت فيمن رجمه، فرجمناه بالمصلى، فلما أذلقته الحجارة هرب، فأدركناه بالحرة فرجمناه.
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٨١٥-٦٨١٦)، ومسلم (١٦٩١).

6944 — Abū Hurayrah reported:
A man from Aslam came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was in the mosque and called out:
“O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have committed adultery.”
The Prophet ﷺ turned away from him until he repeated his confession four times.
After he had testified against himself four times, the Prophet ﷺ called him and asked:
“Are you insane?”
He replied:
“No.”
He asked:
“Have you previously been married?”
He replied:
“Yes.”
The Prophet ﷺ then said:
“Take him away and stone him.”
Ibn Shihāb said:
Someone who heard Jābir ibn ʿAbdullāh informed me that Jābir said:
“I was among those who stoned him. We stoned him at the prayer place. When the stones caused him severe pain, he fled. We caught up with him at al-Ḥarrah and stoned him.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhārī (6815–6816) and Muslim (1691).

٦٩٤٥ — عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: جَاءَ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ، فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ، فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ، فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ، فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ حَتَّى قَالَهَا أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ أَنْ يُرْجَمَ. فَلَمَّا أَصَابَتْهُ الْحِجَارَةُ أَدْبَرَ يَشْتَدُّ، فَلَقِيَهُ رَجُلٌ بِيَدِهِ لَحْيُ جَمَلٍ فَضَرَبَهُ فَصَرَعَهُ، فَذُكِرَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِرَارُهُ حِينَ مَسَّتْهُ الْحِجَارَةُ فَقَالَ: فَهَلَّا تَرَكْتُمُوهُ؟

6945 — Abu Hurayrah said: Māʿiz ibn Mālik came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “I have committed adultery.” The Prophet ﷺ turned away from him. Then he repeated it, and the Prophet ﷺ turned away again. Then he repeated it again, and again the Prophet ﷺ turned away, until he said it four times. The Prophet ﷺ then ordered that he be stoned.
When the stones struck him, he fled in panic. A man met him holding a jawbone of a camel and struck him, knocking him down. This was mentioned to the Prophet ﷺ regarding his attempt to escape when the stones struck him, and he said: “Why did you not leave him alone?”
 Hasan: narrated by al-Tirmidhī (1428), Ibn Mājah (2554), Aḥmad (9809), Ibn al-Jārūd (819), Ibn Ḥibbān (4439), al-Ḥākim (363/4), al-Bayhaqī (228/8).

٦٩٤٦ — عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: جَاءَ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ، كُلَّ ذَلِكَ يَرُدُّهُ وَيَقُولُ: «أَأَخْبَرْتَ أَحَدًا غَيْرِي؟» ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِرَجْمِهِ، فَذَهَبُوا بِهِ إِلَى مَكَانٍ يَبْلُغُ صَدْرُهُ إِلَى حَائِطٍ، فَذَهَبَ يَثِبُ، فَرَمَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَأَصَابَ أَصْلَ أُذُنَيْهِ، فَصُرِعَ فَقَتَلَهُ.
حسن: رواه النسائي في الكبرى (٧١٦٣).

english_source:
6946 — A man from the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ said: Maʿiz ibn Mālik came to the Prophet ﷺ four times, and each time he would turn him away, saying: “Have you informed anyone other than me?” Then he ordered that he be stoned. They took him to a place where a wall reached up to his chest. He tried to leap away, but a man struck him, hitting the base of his ears, so he fell and was killed.
Hasan: Narrated by al-Nasā’ī in al-Kubrā (7163).

٦٩٤٨ — عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ حِينَ جِيءَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، رَجُلًا قَصِيرًا أَعْضَلَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ رِدَاءٌ، فَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ أَنَّهُ زَنَى، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «فَلَعَلَّكَ…» قَالَ: لَا، وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ قَدْ زَنَى الْآخَرُ، قَالَ: فَرَجَمَهُ. ثُمَّ خَطَبَ فَقَالَ: «أَلَا كُلَّمَا نَفَرْنَا غَازِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ خَلَفَ أَحَدُهُمْ لَهُ نَبِيبٌ كَنَبِيبِ التَّيْسِ، يَمْنَحُ أَحَدُهُمْ الْكُثْبَةَ، أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ يُمَكِّنِي اللَّهُ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمْ لَأُنَكِّلَنَّ بِهِ».
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٦٩٢).

٦٩٤٩ — عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ: «أَحَقٌّ مَا بَلَغَنِي عَنْكَ؟» قَالَ: وَمَا بَلَغَكَ عَنِّي؟ قَالَ: «بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ وَقَعْتَ بِجَارِيَةِ آلِ فُلَانٍ» قَالَ: نَعَمْ، فَشَهِدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ.

صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٦٩٥).

6951 — Buraydah ibn al-Ḥuṣayb reported that Maʿiz ibn Mālik al-Aslamī came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have wronged myself and committed adultery, and I want you to purify me.” He turned him away. The next day he came again and said the same, and he turned him away a second time. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then sent to his people and said: “Do you find anything wrong with his mind? Do you deny anything about him?” They said: “We do not know anything about him except that he is among our best and most sound in mind.” He came a third time, and he again sent to them and they informed him the same. When it was the fourth time, a pit was dug for him and then he was ordered to be stoned.
Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (1695).

٦٩٥١ — عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْبِ أَنَّ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الْأَسْلَمِيَّ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي قَدْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَزَنَيْتُ، وَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ تُطَهِّرَنِي، فَرَدَّهُ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ مِنَ الْغَدِ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ زَنَيْتُ، فَرَدَّهُ الثَّانِيَةَ، فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ: «أَتَعْلَمُونَ بِعَقْلِهِ بَأْسًا أَتُنْكِرُونَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا؟» فَقَالُوا: مَا نَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا وَفِيًّا مِنْ صَالِحِينَا، فَأَتَاهُ الثَّالِثَةَ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَيْضًا، فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّهُ لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ وَلَا بِعَقْلِهِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَتِ الرَّابِعَةُ حُفِرَ لَهُ حُفْرَةٌ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ.

6952 — Abū Saʿīd reported that a man from Aslam called Maʿiz ibn Mālik came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “I have committed an indecent act, so carry out the punishment on me.” The Prophet ﷺ turned him away repeatedly. Then he asked his people about him. They said: “We know nothing wrong about him except that he did something from which he believes nothing will purify him except the prescribed punishment.” So the Prophet ﷺ ordered that he be stoned. We went with him to Baqīʿ al-Gharqad. We did not bind him or dig for him. We threw bones, clods of earth, and pieces of pottery at him, and he ran and we chased him until he reached Ḥarrah. Then he stood firm, and we stoned him with large stones. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon saying: “Whenever we go out on expeditions in the path of Allah, one of them stays behind among our families, with a bleating like the bleating of a ram. I will not be brought a man who does that except that I will make an example of him.”
Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (1694).

٦٩٥٣ — عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ قَالَ: بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَنَحْنُ قُعُودٌ مَعَهُ إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَيَّ، فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ، وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ: «أَرَأَيْتَ حِينَ خَرَجْتَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ، أَلَيْسَ قَدْ تَوَضَّأْتَ فَأَحْسَنْتَ الْوُضُوءَ؟» قَالَ: بَلَى، قَالَ: «ثُمَّ شَهِدْتَ الصَّلَاةَ مَعَنَا؟» قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ غَفَرَ لَكَ حَدَّكَ أَوْ ذَنْبَكَ».

6954 — Yazīd ibn Nuʿaym ibn Hazzāl, from his father, reported: Maʿiz ibn Mālik was an orphan in my father’s care. He committed indecency with a girl from the tribe, so my father said to him: “Go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and inform him of what you have done; perhaps he will seek forgiveness for you.” So he went and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have committed adultery, so carry out upon me the Book of Allah.” He turned away from him, then he returned and repeated it four times. The Prophet ﷺ said: “With whom?” He said: “So-and-so.” He said: “Did you lie with her?” He said: “Yes.” He said: “Did you have intimate contact?” He said: “Yes.” He said: “Did you have intercourse?” He said: “Yes.” So he ordered that he be stoned. He was taken out to al-Ḥarrah, and when the stones struck him he panicked and ran. Then ʿAbdullāh ibn Unays met him and threw the bone of a camel’s foreleg at him, striking and killing him. Then the Prophet ﷺ said: “Why did you not leave him—perhaps he would have repented, and Allah would have accepted his repentance.”
Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4419).

٦٩٥٥ — عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ نَصْرِ بْنِ دَهْرٍ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَهُ، فَلَمَّا وَجَدَ مَسَّ الْحِجَارَةِ جَزِعَ جَزَعًا شَدِيدًا، فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللّٰه ﷺ، قَالَ: (( فَهَلَّا تَرَكْتُمُوهُ؟ ))
 قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ: فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ حِينَ سَمِعْتُهُ: (( أَلا تَرَكْتُمُوهُ )) لِعَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ، فَقَالَ لِي: حَدَّثَنِي حَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ذَلِكَ مِنْ قَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللّٰه ﷺ: (( أَلا تَرَكْتُمُوهُ لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ )) مِنْ ثِقَةٍ مِنْ رِجَالِ أَسْلَمَ قَبْلًا، وَلَمْ أَعْرِفْ وَجْهَ حَدِيثٍ، فَجِئْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللّٰه فَقُلْتُ: إِنَّ رِجَالَ أَسْلَمَ يُحَدِّثُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللّٰه ﷺ قَالَ لَهُمْ حِينَ ذَكَرُوا جَزَعَ مَاعِزٍ مِنَ الْحِجَارَةِ حِينَ أَصَابَتْهُ: (( فَهَلَّا تَرَكْتُمُوهُ؟ )) وَمَا أَتَّهِمُ الْقَوْمَ وَلَا أَعْرِفُ الْحَدِيثَ، قَالَ: يَا ابْنَ أَخِي أَنَا أَعْلَمُ النَّاسِ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ، كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَ الرَّجُلَ، إِنَّا لَمَّا خَرَجْنَا بِهِ فَرَجَمْنَاهُ فَوَجَدَ مَسَّ الْحِجَارَةِ، صَرَخَ بِنَا: يَا قَوْمِ رُدُّونِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللّٰه ﷺ، فَإِنَّ قَوْمِي قَتَلُونِي وَغَرُّونِي مِنْ نَفْسِي، وَأَخْبَرُونِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللّٰه غَيْرُ قَاتِلِي. فَلَمْ نَنْتَزِعْ عَنْهُ حَتَّى قَتَلْنَاهُ، فَلَمَّا ذَهَبْنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللّٰه ﷺ قَالَ: (( فَهَلَّا تَرَكْتُمُ الرَّجُلَ وَجِئْتُمُونِي بِهِ فَيَتَثَبَّتَ رَسُولُ اللّٰه لِمَا بَلَغَهُ، فَأَمَّا تَرْكُ حَدٍّ فَلَا ))
 حَسَنٌ: رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ (٤٤٢٠)، وَالنَّسَائِيُّ فِي الْكُبْرَى (٧٢٩٧)، وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ، وَالطَّحَاوِيُّ فِي مُشْكِلِهِ (٤٣٤).

6955 — Abu al-Haytham ibn Nasr ibn Dahr al-Aslami, from his father, said: I was among those who stoned him. When he felt the touch of the stones, he became extremely distressed, and we mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: “Why did you not leave him?”
Muhammad said: I mentioned this narration when I heard it—“Why did you not leave him?”—to ‘Asim ibn ‘Umar ibn Qatadah. He said to me: Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib told me that he narrated this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: “Why did you not leave him (Ma‘iz ibn Malik)?” from reliable men among the people of Aslam earlier. I did not fully understand the chain, so I went to Jabir ibn ‘Abd Allah and said: The men of Aslam narrate that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them when they mentioned Ma‘iz’s panic from the stones: “Why did you not leave him?” I do not accuse them, but I do not know this narration.
He said: O my nephew, I am the most knowledgeable of this hadith. I was among those who stoned the man. When we went out with him and stoned him, he felt the impact of the stones and cried out: “O people, return me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, for my people have killed me and deceived me about myself, and told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not kill me.” But we did not stop until we killed him. When we went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: “Why did you not leave the man and bring him to me so that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ could verify what had reached him? As for leaving a legal punishment (ḥadd), that is not permissible.”
Hasan: narrated by Abu Dawud (4420), al-Nasa’i in al-Kubra (7297), wording from him, and al-Tahawi in Mushkil al-Athar (434).

 حَسَنٌ: رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ (٤٤٢٠)، وَالنَّسَائِيُّ فِي الْكُبْرَى (٧٢٩٧)، وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ، وَالطَّحَاوِيُّ فِي مُشْكِلِهِ (٤٣٤).
6955 — Abu al-Haytham ibn Nasr ibn Dahr al-Aslami, from his father, said: I was among those who stoned him. When he felt the touch of the stones, he became extremely distressed, and we mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: “Why did you not leave him?”
Muhammad said: I mentioned this narration when I heard it—“Why did you not leave him?”—to ‘Asim ibn ‘Umar ibn Qatadah. He said to me: Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib told me that he narrated this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: “Why did you not leave him (Ma‘iz ibn Malik)?” from reliable men among the people of Aslam earlier. I did not fully understand the chain, so I went to Jabir ibn ‘Abd Allah and said: The men of Aslam narrate that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them when they mentioned Ma‘iz’s panic from the stones: “Why did you not leave him?” I do not accuse them, but I do not know this narration.
He said: O my nephew, I am the most knowledgeable of this hadith. I was among those who stoned the man. When we went out with him and stoned him, he felt the impact of the stones and cried out: “O people, return me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, for my people have killed me and deceived me about myself, and told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not kill me.” But we did not stop until we killed him. When we went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: “Why did you not leave the man and bring him to me so that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ could verify what had reached him? As for leaving a legal punishment (ḥadd), that is not permissible.”
Hasan: narrated by Abu Dawud (4420), al-Nasa’i in al-Kubra (7297), wording from him, and al-Tahawi in Mushkil al-Athar (434).

٦٩٥٦ — عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْبِ أَنَّ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الأَسْلَمِيَّ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللّٰه ﷺ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه! إِنِّي قَدْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَزَنَيْتُ وَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ تُطَهِّرَنِي، فَرَدَّهُ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ مِنَ الْغَدِ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه! إِنِّي قَدْ زَنَيْتُ، فَرَدَّهُ الثَّانِيَةَ، فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللّٰه ﷺ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ: (( أَتَعْلَمُونَ بِعَقْلِهِ بَأْسًا تُنْكِرُونَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا؟ )) فَقَالُوا: مَا نَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا وَفِي الْعَقْلِ مِنْ صَالِحِينَا فِيمَا نَرَى، فَأَتَاهُ الثَّالِثَةَ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَيْضًا فَسَأَلَ عَنْهُ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّهُ لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ وَلَا بِعَقْلِهِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ الرَّابِعَةَ حَفَرَ لَهُ حُفْرَةً ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ.
ثُمَّ جَاءَتِ الْغَامِدِيَّةُ فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه! إِنِّي قَدْ زَنَيْتُ فَطَهِّرْنِي. وَإِنَّهُ رَدَّهَا، فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْغَدُ قَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه! لَمْ تَرُدُّنِي؟ لَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تَرُدَّنِي كَمَا رَدَدْتَ مَاعِزًا، فَوَاللّٰهِ إِنِّي لَحُبْلَى. قَالَ: (( إِمَّا لَا فَاذْهَبِي حَتَّى تَلِدِي )) فَلَمَّا وَلَدَتْ أُتِيَ بِالصَّبِيِّ فِي خِرْقَةٍ، قَالَتْ: هَذَا قَدْ وَلَدْتُهُ، قَالَ: (( اذْهَبِي فَأَرْضِعِيهِ حَتَّى تَفْطِمِيهِ )) فَلَمَّا فَطَمَتْهُ أُتِيَ بِهِ فِي يَدِهِ كُسْرَةُ خُبْزٍ، فَقَالَتْ: هَذَا قَدْ فَطَمْتُهُ وَقَدْ أَكَلَ الطَّعَامَ، فَدَفَعَ الصَّبِيَّ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَحُفِرَ لَهَا إِلَى صَدْرِهَا وَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ فَرَجَمُوهَا، فَأَقْبَلَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بِحَجَرٍ فَرَمَى رَأْسَهَا فَتَنَضَّحَ الدَّمُ عَلَى وَجْهِ خَالِدٍ فَسَبَّهَا، فَسَمِعَ نَبِيُّ اللّٰه ﷺ سَبَّهَا فَقَالَ: (( مَهْلًا يَا خَالِدُ! فَوَاللّٰهِ الَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ تَابَهَا صَاحِبُ مَكْسٍ لَغُفِرَ لَهُ )) ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا وَدُفِنَتْ.
صَحِيحٌ: رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ (٢٣:١٦٩٥).

english_source:
6956 — Buraidah ibn al-Hasib said: Ma‘iz ibn Malik al-Aslami came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have wronged myself and committed adultery, and I want you to purify me.” He turned him away. The next day he came again and said the same. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent to his people and said: “Do you find any defect in his intellect?” They said: We do not know anything wrong with him; he is among our righteous ones in intellect. He came a third time, and again they were asked and said the same. On the fourth time, the Prophet ﷺ dug a pit for him and ordered that he be stoned.
Then the Ghamidiyyah woman came and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have committed adultery, so purify me.” He turned her away. The next day she said: “Why do you refuse me? Perhaps you will refuse me as you refused Ma‘iz. By Allah, I am pregnant.” He said: “If that is so, then go until you give birth.” When she gave birth, she came with the child wrapped in cloth and said: “This is what I have given birth to.” He said: “Go and breastfeed him until you wean him.” When she weaned him, she brought him with a piece of bread in his hand and said: “I have weaned him and he is eating food.” He handed the child to a Muslim man, then ordered that she be dug up to her chest and the people stoned her. Khalid ibn al-Walid came forward with a stone and struck her head, and blood splattered onto his face, so he insulted her. The Prophet ﷺ heard him and said: “Gently, O Khalid! By the One in Whose hand is my soul, she has repented a repentance that if the tax collector (ṣāḥib maks) had repented it, he would have been forgiven.” Then he ordered that she be prayed over and buried.
Ṣaḥīḥ: narrated by Muslim (1695).

ثُمَّ جَاءَتِ الْغَامِدِيَّةُ فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه! إِنِّي قَدْ زَنَيْتُ فَطَهِّرْنِي. وَإِنَّهُ رَدَّهَا، فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْغَدُ قَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه! لَمْ تَرُدُّنِي؟ لَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تَرُدَّنِي كَمَا رَدَدْتَ مَاعِزًا، فَوَاللّٰهِ إِنِّي لَحُبْلَى. قَالَ: (( إِمَّا لَا فَاذْهَبِي حَتَّى تَلِدِي )) فَلَمَّا وَلَدَتْ أُتِيَ بِالصَّبِيِّ فِي خِرْقَةٍ، قَالَتْ: هَذَا قَدْ وَلَدْتُهُ، قَالَ: (( اذْهَبِي فَأَرْضِعِيهِ حَتَّى تَفْطِمِيهِ )) فَلَمَّا فَطَمَتْهُ أُتِيَ بِهِ فِي يَدِهِ كُسْرَةُ خُبْزٍ، فَقَالَتْ: هَذَا قَدْ فَطَمْتُهُ وَقَدْ أَكَلَ الطَّعَامَ، فَدَفَعَ الصَّبِيَّ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَحُفِرَ لَهَا إِلَى صَدْرِهَا وَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ فَرَجَمُوهَا، فَأَقْبَلَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بِحَجَرٍ فَرَمَى رَأْسَهَا فَتَنَضَّحَ الدَّمُ عَلَى وَجْهِ خَالِدٍ فَسَبَّهَا، فَسَمِعَ نَبِيُّ اللّٰه ﷺ سَبَّهَا فَقَالَ: (( مَهْلًا يَا خَالِدُ! فَوَاللّٰهِ الَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ تَابَهَا صَاحِبُ مَكْسٍ لَغُفِرَ لَهُ )) ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا وَدُفِنَتْ.
صَحِيحٌ: رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ (٢٣:١٦٩٥).
6956 — Buraidah ibn al-Hasib said: Ma‘iz ibn Malik al-Aslami came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have wronged myself and committed adultery, and I want you to purify me.” He turned him away. The next day he came again and said the same. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent to his people and said: “Do you find any defect in his intellect?” They said: We do not know anything wrong with him; he is among our righteous ones in intellect. He came a third time, and again they were asked and said the same. On the fourth time, the Prophet ﷺ dug a pit for him and ordered that he be stoned.
Then the Ghamidiyyah woman came and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have committed adultery, so purify me.” He turned her away. The next day she said: “Why do you refuse me? Perhaps you will refuse me as you refused Ma‘iz. By Allah, I am pregnant.” He said: “If that is so, then go until you give birth.” When she gave birth, she came with the child wrapped in cloth and said: “This is what I have given birth to.” He said: “Go and breastfeed him until you wean him.” When she weaned him, she brought him with a piece of bread in his hand and said: “I have weaned him and he is eating food.” He handed the child to a Muslim man, then ordered that she be dug up to her chest and the people stoned her. Khalid ibn al-Walid came forward with a stone and struck her head, and blood splattered onto his face, so he insulted her. The Prophet ﷺ heard him and said: “Gently, O Khalid! By the One in Whose hand is my soul, she has repented a repentance that if the tax collector (ṣāḥib maks) had repented it, he would have been forgiven.” Then he ordered that she be prayed over and buried.
Ṣaḥīḥ: narrated by Muslim (1695).

٦٩٥٧ — عن بريدة قال:
جاء ماعز بن مالك إلى النبي ﷺ فقال:
يا رسول الله ﷺ، طهرني.
فقال:
«وَيْحَكَ! ارْجِعْ فَاسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَتُبْ إِلَيْهِ».
قال: فرجع غير بعيد، ثم جاء فقال:
يا رسول الله ﷺ، طهرني.
فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
«وَيْحَكَ! ارْجِعْ فَاسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَتُبْ إِلَيْهِ».
حتى إذا كانت الرابعة قال له رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
«فِيمَ أُطَهِّرُكَ؟»
فقال:
من الزنى.
فسأل رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
«أَبِهِ جُنُونٌ؟»
فأخبر أنه ليس بمجنون.
فقال:
«أَشَرِبَ خَمْرًا؟»
فقام رجل فاستنكهه، فلم يجد منه ريح خمر.
فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
«أَزَنَيْتَ؟»
فقال: نعم.
فأمر به فرجم.
فكان الناس فيه فرقتين: قائل يقول: لقد هلك، لقد أحاطت به خطيئته. وقائل يقول: ما توبة أفضل من توبة ماعز؛ إنه جاء إلى النبي ﷺ فوضع يده في يده، ثم قال: اقتلني بالحجارة.
قال: فلبثوا بذلك يومين أو ثلاثة، ثم جاء رسول اللّٰه ﷺ وهم جلوس، فسلم ثم جلس، فقال:
«اسْتَغْفِرُوا لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ».
فقالوا:
غفر الله لماعز بن مالك.
فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
«لَقَدْ تَابَ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِّمَتْ بَيْنَ أُمَّةٍ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ».
قال:
ثم جاءته امرأة من غامد من الأزد فقالت:
يا رسول الله ﷺ، طهرني.
فقال:
«وَيْحَكِ! ارْجِعِي فَاسْتَغْفِرِي اللَّهَ وَتُوبِي إِلَيْهِ».
فقالت:
أراك تريد أن ترددني كما رددت ماعز بن مالك.
قال:
«وَمَا ذَاكِ؟»
قالت:
إنها حبلى من الزنى.
فقال:
«آنْتِ؟»
قالت: نعم.
فقال لها:
«حَتَّى تَضَعِي مَا فِي بَطْنِكِ».
قال: فكفلها رجل من الأنصار حتى وضعت.
فأتى النبي ﷺ فقال:
قد وضعت الغامدية.
فقال:
«إِذًا لَا نَرْجُمُهَا وَنَدَعُ وَلَدَهَا صَغِيرًا لَيْسَ لَهُ مَنْ يُرْضِعُهُ».
فقام رجل من الأنصار فقال:
إلي رضاعه يا نبي الله.
قال: فرجمها.
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٦٩٥/٢٢).

6957 — Buraydah reported:
Māʿiz ibn Mālik came to the Prophet ﷺ and said:
“O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, purify me.”
He said:
“Woe to you! Go back, seek Allah’s forgiveness, and repent to Him.”
He went only a short distance away, then returned and said:
“O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, purify me.”
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ again said:
“Woe to you! Go back, seek Allah’s forgiveness, and repent to Him.”
When he came for the fourth time, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked:
“From what should I purify you?”
He replied:
“From adultery.”
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked:
“Is he insane?”
He was informed that he was not insane.
He then asked:
“Has he drunk wine?”
A man stood up and smelled his breath but found no odor of wine.
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked:
“Did you commit adultery?”
He replied:
“Yes.”
So he ordered that he be stoned.
The people then divided into two groups concerning him. One group said:
“He has been destroyed; his sin has encompassed him.”
The other said:
“There is no repentance better than the repentance of Māʿiz. He came to the Prophet ﷺ, placed his hand in his hand, and said: ‘Kill me with stones.’”
They continued discussing him for two or three days.
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came while they were sitting. He greeted them, sat down, and said:
“Seek forgiveness for Māʿiz ibn Mālik.”
They said:
“May Allah forgive Māʿiz ibn Mālik.”
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“He has repented with a repentance which, if it were divided among an entire community, would suffice them.”
Then a woman from Ghāmid, from the tribe of Azd, came to him and said:
“O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, purify me.”
He said:
“Woe to you! Go back, seek Allah’s forgiveness, and repent to Him.”
She said:

٦٩٥٧ — عن بريدة قال:
جاء ماعز بن مالك إلى النبي ﷺ فقال:
يا رسول الله ﷺ، طهرني.
فقال:
«وَيْحَكَ! ارْجِعْ فَاسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَتُبْ إِلَيْهِ».
قال: فرجع غير بعيد، ثم جاء فقال:
يا رسول الله ﷺ، طهرني.
فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
«وَيْحَكَ! ارْجِعْ فَاسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَتُبْ إِلَيْهِ».
حتى إذا كانت الرابعة قال له رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
«فِيمَ أُطَهِّرُكَ؟»
فقال:
من الزنى.
فسأل رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
«أَبِهِ جُنُونٌ؟»
فأخبر أنه ليس بمجنون.
فقال:
«أَشَرِبَ خَمْرًا؟»
فقام رجل فاستنكهه، فلم يجد منه ريح خمر.
فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
«أَزَنَيْتَ؟»
فقال: نعم.
فأمر به فرجم.
فكان الناس فيه فرقتين: قائل يقول: لقد هلك، لقد أحاطت به خطيئته. وقائل يقول: ما توبة أفضل من توبة ماعز؛ إنه جاء إلى النبي ﷺ فوضع يده في يده، ثم قال: اقتلني بالحجارة.
قال: فلبثوا بذلك يومين أو ثلاثة، ثم جاء رسول اللّٰه ﷺ وهم جلوس، فسلم ثم جلس، فقال:
«اسْتَغْفِرُوا لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ».
فقالوا:
غفر الله لماعز بن مالك.
فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
«لَقَدْ تَابَ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِّمَتْ بَيْنَ أُمَّةٍ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ».
قال:
ثم جاءته امرأة من غامد من الأزد فقالت:
يا رسول الله ﷺ، طهرني.
فقال:
«وَيْحَكِ! ارْجِعِي فَاسْتَغْفِرِي اللَّهَ وَتُوبِي إِلَيْهِ».
فقالت:
أراك تريد أن ترددني كما رددت ماعز بن مالك.
قال:
«وَمَا ذَاكِ؟»
قالت:
إنها حبلى من الزنى.
فقال:
«آنْتِ؟»
قالت: نعم.
فقال لها:
«حَتَّى تَضَعِي مَا فِي بَطْنِكِ».
قال: فكفلها رجل من الأنصار حتى وضعت.
فأتى النبي ﷺ فقال:
قد وضعت الغامدية.
فقال:
«إِذًا لَا نَرْجُمُهَا وَنَدَعُ وَلَدَهَا صَغِيرًا لَيْسَ لَهُ مَنْ يُرْضِعُهُ».
فقام رجل من الأنصار فقال:
إلي رضاعه يا نبي الله.
قال: فرجمها.
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٦٩٥/٢٢).

Hasan: Narrated by al-Nasa’i in al-Kubra (7149), al-Daraqutni (3228), and al-Hakim (4/364).

٦٩٥٩ — عن عمران بن الحصين، أن امرأة من جهينة أتت نبي اللّٰه ﷺ وهي حبلى من الزنى، فقالت: يا نبي الله! أصبت حداً فأقمه علي. فدعا نبي اللّٰه ﷺ وليها. فقال: (( أحسن إليها. فإذا وضعت فائتني بها )) ففعل فأمر بها نبي اللّٰه ﷺ فشكت عليها ثيابها. ثم أمر بها فرجمت. ثم صلى عليها. فقال له عمر: تصلي عليها؟ يا نبي الله! وقد زنت. فقال: (( لقد تابت توبة لو قسمت بين سبعين من أهل المدينة لوسعتهم. وهل وجدت توبة أفضل من أن جادت بنفسها لله تعالى )).
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٦٩٦).

٦٩٦٠ — عن أبي هريرة وزيد بن خالد الجهني، أن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ سئل عن الأمة إذا زنتْ ولم تحصن؟ فقال: (( إن زنت فاجلدوها، ثم إن زنت فاجلدوها، ثم إن زنت فاجلدوها. ثم بيعوها ولو بضفير )).
قال ابن شهاب: “لا أدري أبعد الثالثة أو الرابعة”.
متفق عليه: رواه مالك (١٤) والبخاري (٦٨٣٧، ٦٨٣٨) ومسلم (٣٢:١٧٠٣).

6960 — Abu Hurayrah and Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about a slave woman who commits adultery while unmarried. He said: “If she commits adultery, then flog her. Then if she commits adultery again, flog her. Then if she commits adultery again, flog her. Then sell her even for a braided rope.”
Ibn Shihab said: “I do not know whether that was after the third or fourth offense.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by Malik (14), al-Bukhari (6837, 6838), and Muslim (1703).

٦٩٦١ — عن أبي هريرة أنه سمعه يقول: قال النبي ﷺ: (( إذا زنت الأمة فتبين زناها فليجلدها ولا يثرّب، ثم إن زنت فليجلدها ولا يثرّب، ثم إن زنت الثالثة فليبعها ولو بحبل من شعر )).
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٨٣٩) ومسلم (٣٠:١٧٠٣).

6961 — Abu Hurayrah reported that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “If a slave woman commits adultery and her adultery becomes clear, then let her be flogged and not rebuked harshly. Then if she commits adultery again, let her be flogged and not rebuked harshly. Then if she commits adultery a third time, let her be sold even for a rope made of hair.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6839) and Muslim (1703).

arabic_source:
٦٩٦٢ — عن أبي عبد الرحمن قال: خطب علي فقال: يا أيها الناس أقيموا على أرقّائكم الحدّ، من أحصن منهم ومن لم يُحصن، فإن أمة لرسول اللّٰه ﷺ زنت، فأمرني أن أجلدها، فإذا هي حديث عهد بنفاس، فخشيت إن أنا جلدتها أن أقتلها فذكرت ذلك للنبي ﷺ، فقال: (( أحسنت )).
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٧٠٦). وفي رواية زاد: (( اتركها حتى تماثل )).
قوله: (( أقيموا على أرقائكم الحد )) الظاهر أنه مدرج في الحديث من قول علي، وليس بمرفوع، ولكن له حكم الرفع لأنه هو الذي أنابه رسول اللّٰه ﷺ في جلد الأمة الزانية.
والجارية لم تكن لرسول اللّٰه ﷺ، إنما كانت لبعض عشيرته، لأن اللّٰه طهّر بيت النبي ﷺ من الرجس كما رواه أبو داود (٤٤٧٣)، وأحمد (٦٧٩)، والبيهقي (٢٤٥/٨) كلهم من طرق عن عبد الأعلى الثعلبي، عن أبي جميلة، عن علي رضي اللّٰه عنه قال: فجرت جارية لآل رسول اللّٰه ﷺ.

6962 — Abu Abd al-Rahman reported: Ali delivered a sermon and said: “O people, carry out the legal punishment upon your slaves, whether married or unmarried. A slave woman belonging to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ committed adultery, and he ordered me to flog her. But she had recently given birth, so I feared that if I flogged her I might kill her. I mentioned that to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: ‘You did well.’”
In another narration he added: “Leave her until she recovers.”
Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (1706).
Commentary:
 The statement: “Carry out the legal punishment upon your slaves” apparently is inserted from the words of Ali and is not directly raised to the Prophet ﷺ, but it carries the ruling of a raised narration because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ appointed Ali to flog the slave woman who committed adultery.
The slave girl did not belong to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ himself; rather, she belonged to some of his relatives, because Allah purified the household of the Prophet ﷺ from impurity, as narrated by Abu Dawud (4473), Ahmad (679), and al-Bayhaqi (8/245), all through the route of Abd al-A‘la al-Tha‘labi from Abu Jamilah from Ali may Allah be pleased with him who said: “A slave girl belonging to the family of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ committed adultery.”

The slave girl did not belong to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ himself; rather, she belonged to some of his relatives, because Allah purified the household of the Prophet ﷺ from impurity, as narrated by Abu Dawud (4473), Ahmad (679), and al-Bayhaqi (8/245), all through the route of Abd al-A‘la al-Tha‘labi from Abu Jamilah from Ali may Allah be pleased with him who said: “A slave girl belonging to the family of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ committed adultery.”

٦٩٦٣ — عن أبي هريرة، وزيد بن خالد الجهني، أنهما أخبراه أن رجلين اختصما إلى رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فقال أحدهما: يا رسول اللّٰه ﷺ اقض بيننا بكتاب الله. وقال الآخر - وهو أفقههما - : أجل يا رسول الله ﷺ، فاقض بيننا بكتاب الله، وائذن لي أن أتكلم. قال: (( تكلم )) فقال: إن ابني كان عسيفاً على هذا، فزنى بامرأته، فأخبروني أن على ابني الرجم، فافتديت منه بمائة شاة وبجارية لي. ثم إني سألت أهل العلم، فأخبروني: أنما على ابني جلد مائة وتغريب عام، وإنما الرجم على امرأته، فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( أما والذي نفسي بيده، لأقضين بينكما بكتاب الله، أما غنمك وجاريتك فردٌّ عليك )) وجلد ابنه مائة، وغرّبه عاماً. وأمر أنيساً الأسلمي أن يأتي امرأة الآخر، (( فإن اعترفت فارجمها ))، فاعترفت فرجمها.

6963 — Abu Hurayrah and Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani reported: Two men brought a dispute before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. One of them said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, judge between us according to the Book of Allah.” The other, who was more knowledgeable, said: “Yes, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, judge between us according to the Book of Allah, and permit me to speak.” He said: “Speak.”
He said: “My son was a laborer working for this man, and he committed adultery with his wife. I was informed that my son deserved stoning, so I ransomed him with one hundred sheep and a servant girl of mine. Then I asked the people of knowledge, and they informed me that my son only deserved one hundred lashes and exile for one year, while stoning applied only to the woman.”
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “By the One in whose hand is my soul, I will judge between you according to the Book of Allah. Your sheep and servant girl are to be returned to you.” He then ordered that the son be lashed one hundred times and exiled for one year. He also ordered Unays al-Aslami to go to the other man’s wife and said: “If she confesses, then stone her.” She confessed, so she was stoned.
Agreed upon: Narrated by Malik (6), al-Bukhari (6842, 6843), and Muslim (1697, 1698).

٦٩٦٤ — عن زيد بن خالد الجهني قال: سمعت النبي ﷺ يأمر فيمن زنى، ولم يحصن: جلد مائة وتغريب عام.
قال ابن شهاب: وأخبرني عروة بن الزبير: أن عمر بن الخطاب غرّب، ثم لم تزل تلك السنة.
صحيح: رواه البخاري (٦٨٣١، ٦٨٣٢).

6964 — Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ command regarding one who committed adultery while unmarried: “One hundred lashes and exile for one year.”
Ibn Shihab said: ‘Urwah ibn al-Zubayr informed me that Umar ibn al-Khattab carried out exile, and that practice continued thereafter.
Sahih: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6831, 6832).

٦٩٦٥ — عن ابن عباس أنه قال: سمعت عمر بن الخطاب يقول: الرجم في كتاب اللّٰه حق على من زنى من الرجال والنساء إذا أحصن، إذا قامت البينة، أو كان الحبل أو الاعتراف.
متفق عليه: رواه مالك (٨)، ورواه الشيخان من وجوه أخرى.

6965 — Ibn Abbas reported: I heard Umar ibn al-Khattab say: “Stoning is a true ruling in the Book of Allah upon married men and women who commit adultery, when evidence is established, or there is pregnancy, or confession.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by Malik (8), and also narrated by al-Bukhari and Muslim through other chains.

6966 — Ibn Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If I were to stone anyone without clear evidence, I would have stoned that woman. Suspicion had become apparent from her speech, her appearance, and those who entered upon her.”
Sahih: Narrated by Ibn Majah (2559).

٦٩٦٧ — عن القاسم بن محمد، قال: قال عبد اللّٰه بن شداد - وذكر المتلاعنان عند ابن عباس - فقال ابن شداد: أهما اللذان قال النبي ﷺ: (( لو كنت راجماً أحداً بغير بينة لرجمتهما! )) فقال ابن عباس: لا، تلك امرأة أعلنت.
وفي رواية: (( لا، تلك امرأة كانت تظهر في الإسلام السوء )).
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٨٥٥) ومسلم (١٣:١٤٩٧).

6967 — Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad reported: Abdullah ibn Shaddad mentioned the two people involved in mutual cursing before Ibn Abbas. Ibn Shaddad said: “Are these the two about whom the Prophet ﷺ said: ‘If I were to stone anyone without evidence, I would have stoned them?’”
Ibn Abbas replied: “No, that was a woman who openly displayed immorality.”
In another narration: “No, that was a woman who openly displayed evil in Islam.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6855) and Muslim (1497).

In another narration: “No, that was a woman who openly displayed evil in Islam.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6855) and Muslim (1497).

٦٩٦٧ — عن القاسم بن محمد، قال: قال عبد اللّٰه بن شداد - وذكر المتلاعنان عند ابن عباس - فقال ابن شداد: أهما اللذان قال النبي ﷺ: (( لو كنت راجماً أحداً بغير بينة لرجمتهما! )) فقال ابن عباس: لا، تلك امرأة أعلنت.
وفي رواية: (( لا، تلك امرأة كانت تظهر في الإسلام السوء )).
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٨٥٥) ومسلم (١٣:١٤٩٧).

٦٩٦٨ — عن المغيرة بن شعبة قال: قال سعد بن عبادة: لو رأيت رجلاً مع امرأتي لضربته بالسيف غير مُصفح! فبلغ ذلك النبي ﷺ فقال: (( أتعجبون من غيرة سعد؟ لأنا أغير منه، والله أغير مني )).
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٨٤٦) ومسلم (١٧:١٤٩٩).

Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6846) and Muslim (1499).

٦٩٦٩ — عن أبي هريرة قال: قال سعد بن عبادة: يا رسول الله ﷺ، لو وجدت مع أهلي رجلاً لم أمسه حتى آتي بأربعة شهداء؟ قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( نعم )) قال: كلا، والذي بعثك بالحق إن كنت لأُعاجله بالسيف قبل ذلك. قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( اسمعوا إلى ما يقول سيّدكم، إنه لغيور، وأنا أغير منه، والله أغير مني )).
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٦:١٤٩٨).

6969 — Abu Hurayrah reported: Sa‘d ibn ‘Ubadah said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, if I found a man with my wife, would I not touch him until I brought four witnesses?” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Yes.” Sa‘d said: “No! By the One who sent you with the truth, I would hasten against him with the sword before that.” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Listen to what your leader says. He possesses protective jealousy, and I have more protective jealousy than him, and Allah has more protective jealousy than me.”
Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (1498).

٦٩٧١ — عن سهل بن سعد، عن النبي ﷺ أن رجلاً أتاه فأقر عنده أنه أتى بامرأة سماها له، فبعث رسول اللّٰه ﷺ إلى المرأة، فسألها عن ذلك، فأنكرت أن تكون زنت، فجلده الحد وتركها.
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٣٧، ٤٤٦٦) والبيهقي (٢٢٨/٨).

6971 — Sahl ibn Sa‘d reported that a man came to the Prophet ﷺ and confessed before him that he had relations with a woman whom he named. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent for the woman and asked her about it, but she denied having committed adultery. So he carried out the punishment upon the man and left her.
Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4437, 4466) and al-Bayhaqi (8/228).

٦٩٧٢ — عن أبي أمامة بن سهل بن حنيف قال: أخبرني بعض أصحاب رسول اللّٰه ﷺ من الأنصار أنه اشتكى رجل منهم حتى أُضْنيَ فعاد جلده على عظمٍ. فدخلت جارية لبعضهم، فهشّ إليها، فوقع عليها. فلما دخل عليه رجال من قومه يعودونه أخبرهم بذلك. وقال: استفتوا لي رسول اللّٰه ﷺ إني قد وقعت على جارية دخلتْ عليّ. فذكروا ذلك لرسول اللّٰه ﷺ فقالوا: يا رسول اللّٰه ﷺ ما رأينا بأحد من الناس من الضُّر مثل الذي هو به، لو حملناه إليك لتفسّخت عظامه، ما هو إلا جلد على عظم. فأمرهم رسول اللّٰه ﷺ بمائة شِمراخٍ، فيضربونه ضربة واحدة.
صحيح: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٧٢) وابن الجارود (٨١٧).
وقوله: (( أُضْني )) أي أصابه الضَّنى، وهو شدة المرض وسوء الحال حتى ينحل بدنه.

6972 — Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf reported: Some companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from the Ansar informed me that a man among them became severely ill until his skin clung to his bones. A slave girl entered upon him, and he desired her and had relations with her. When some men from his people visited him, he informed them of what had happened and said: “Ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for a ruling regarding me, for I had relations with a slave girl who entered upon me.”
They mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we have never seen anyone in such hardship as him. If we carried him to you, his bones would break apart; he is nothing but skin over bone.” So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered them to take one hundred palm stalks and strike him once with them.
Sahih: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4472) and Ibn al-Jarud (817).
The phrase “uḍni” means that he was afflicted with severe illness and weakness until his body wasted away.

٦٩٧٢ — عن أبي أمامة بن سهل بن حنيف قال: أخبرني بعض أصحاب رسول اللّٰه ﷺ من الأنصار أنه اشتكى رجل منهم حتى أُضْنيَ فعاد جلده على عظمٍ. فدخلت جارية لبعضهم، فهشّ إليها، فوقع عليها. فلما دخل عليه رجال من قومه يعودونه أخبرهم بذلك. وقال: استفتوا لي رسول اللّٰه ﷺ إني قد وقعت على جارية دخلتْ عليّ. فذكروا ذلك لرسول اللّٰه ﷺ فقالوا: يا رسول اللّٰه ﷺ ما رأينا بأحد من الناس من الضُّر مثل الذي هو به، لو حملناه إليك لتفسّخت عظامه، ما هو إلا جلد على عظم. فأمرهم رسول اللّٰه ﷺ بمائة شِمراخٍ، فيضربونه ضربة واحدة.
صحيح: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٧٢) وابن الجارود (٨١٧).
وقوله: (( أُضْني )) أي أصابه الضَّنى، وهو شدة المرض وسوء الحال حتى ينحل بدنه.
6972 — Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf reported: Some companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from the Ansar informed me that a man among them became severely ill until his skin clung to his bones. A slave girl entered upon him, and he desired her and had relations with her. When some men from his people visited him, he informed them of what had happened and said: “Ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for a ruling regarding me, for I had relations with a slave girl who entered upon me.”
They mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we have never seen anyone in such hardship as him. If we carried him to you, his bones would break apart; he is nothing but skin over bone.” So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered them to take one hundred palm stalks and strike him once with them.
Sahih: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4472) and Ibn al-Jarud (817).
The phrase “uḍni” means that he was afflicted with severe illness and weakness until his body wasted away.

٦٩٧٤ — عن ابن عباس قال:
مر علي بن أبي طالب بمجنونة بني فلان قد زنت، أمر عمر برجمها، فردها علي، وقال لعمر:
يا أمير المؤمنين، أترجم هذه؟
قال: نعم.
قال:
أوَما تذكر أن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ قال:
«رُفِعَ الْقَلَمُ عَنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ: عَنِ الْمَجْنُونِ الْمَغْلُوبِ عَلَى عَقْلِهِ، وَعَنِ النَّائِمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ، وَعَنِ الصَّبِيِّ حَتَّى يَحْتَلِمَ».
قال:
صدقت.
فخلى عنها.
صحيح: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٠١)، وصححه ابن خزيمة (١٠٠٣)، وابن حبان (١٤٣)، والحاكم (٤/٣٨٩).

6974 — Ibn ʿAbbās reported:
ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib passed by an insane woman from a certain tribe who had committed adultery. ʿUmar had ordered that she be stoned.
ʿAlī had her brought back and said to ʿUmar:
“O Commander of the Believers, will you stone this woman?”
He replied:
“Yes.”
ʿAlī said:
“Do you not remember that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
‘The pen has been lifted from three: from the insane person whose reason is overcome, from the sleeping person until he awakens, and from the child until he reaches puberty’?”
ʿUmar said:
“You are correct.”
So he released her.
Authentic: Narrated by Abū Dāwūd (4401), and authenticated by Ibn Khuzaymah (1003), Ibn Ḥibbān (143), and al-Ḥākim (4/389).

٦٩٧٥ — عن وائل بن حجر قال: خرجت امرأة إلى الصلاة، فلقيها رجل، فتجلّلها بثيابه، فقضى حاجته منها، فصاحت، فانطلق. ومر عليها رجل فقالت: إن ذاك الرجل فعل بي كذا وكذا. ومرت بعصابة من المهاجرين، فقالت: إن ذاك الرجل فعل بي كذا وكذا. فانطلقوا فأخذوا الرجل الذي ظنّت أنه وقع عليها وأتوها، فقالت: نعم هو هذا. فأتوا به رسول اللّٰه ﷺ. فلما أمر به ليرجم قام صاحبها الذي وقع عليها فقال: يا رسول الله ﷺ! أنا صاحبها. فقال لها: (( اذهبي فقد غفر اللّٰه لك )) وقال للرجل قولاً حسناً، فقيل: يا نبي الله! ألا ترجمه؟ فقال: (( لقد تاب توبة لو تابها أهل المدينة لقُبل منهم )).
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٣٧٩) والترمذي (١٤٥٤) وأحمد (٢٧٢٤٠).
قال الترمذي: “حسن غريب صحيح”.

6975 — Wa’il ibn Hujr reported: A woman went out for prayer when a man encountered her, covered her with his garments, and forced himself upon her. She cried out and he fled. Another man passed by and she said: “That man did such-and-such to me.” Then she passed by a group of Muhajirun and said: “That man did such-and-such to me.” They went and seized the man whom she thought had assaulted her and brought him to her. She said: “Yes, this is him.” They then brought him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
When the Prophet ﷺ ordered that he be stoned, the actual perpetrator stood up and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I am the one who did it.” The Prophet ﷺ said to the woman: “Go, for Allah has forgiven you.” He spoke kindly to the man, and it was said: “O Prophet of Allah, will you not stone him?” He replied: “He has repented with such a repentance that if the people of Madinah had repented likewise, it would have been accepted from them.”
Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4379), al-Tirmidhi (1454), and Ahmad (27240).
Al-Tirmidhi said: “Hasan, strange, and authentic.”

٦٩٧٧ — عن أم المؤمنين عائشة قالت: كانت امرأة مخزومية تستعير المتاع وتجحده، فأمر النبي ﷺ أن تُقطع يدها. فأتى أهلها أسامة بن زيد فكلموه، فكلم رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فيها، ثم ذكر نحو حديث الليث ويونس.
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٠:١٦٨٨).

Her family came to Usamah ibn Zayd and spoke to him, so he spoke to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ concerning her. Then he mentioned a narration similar to the hadith of al-Layth and Yunus.
Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (1688).

٦٩٧٨ — عن عبد الله بن عمر قال:
كانت مخزومية تستعير المتاع وتجحده، فأمر النبي ﷺ بقطع يدها.
صحيح: رواه أبو داود (٤٣٩٥)، والنسائي (٤٨٨٧)، وأحمد (٦٣٨٣)، وعبد الرزاق في المصنف (١٠/٢٠٢). 
وقوله: «تستعير المتاع وتجحده» بيان لحال المرأة بأنها كانت تستعير المتاع ثم تجحده، لا أن القطع وقع من أجل الجحد، بل الصحيح أن القطع وقع من أجل السرقة كما في الأحاديث السابقة.
ولذا ذهب عامة أهل العلم إلى أن المستعير إذا جحد العارية لم يقطع؛ لأن الله سبحانه وتعالى إنما أوجب القطع على السارق، وهذا خائن وليس بسارق.

6978 — ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar reported:
A woman from Banū Makhzūm used to borrow goods and then deny having received them, and the Prophet ﷺ ordered that her hand be cut off.
Authentic: Narrated by Abū Dāwūd (4395), al-Nasāʾī (4887), Aḥmad (6383), and ʿAbd al-Razzāq in al-Muṣannaf (10/202). 
The phrase “she used to borrow goods and then deny them” describes the woman’s conduct. It does not mean that her hand was cut off merely because she denied borrowed property. Rather, the correct understanding is that the punishment was imposed because of theft, as indicated by the preceding hadiths.
Accordingly, the majority of scholars held that if a borrower denies having received borrowed property, the hand is not cut off, because Allah prescribed cutting the hand for the thief, whereas such a person is considered a betrayer of trust rather than technically a thief.

٦٩٨٠ — عن محمد بن طلحة بن ركانة، عن أمه عائشة بنت مسعود بن الأسود، عن أبيها قال: لما سرقت المرأة تلك القطيفة من بيت رسول اللّٰه ﷺ أعظمنا ذلك. وكانت امرأة من قريش فجئنا إلى النبي ﷺ نكلمه. وقلنا: نحن نفديها بأربعين أوقية. فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( تطهر خير لها )) فلما سمعنا لين قول رسول اللّٰه ﷺ أتينا أسامة فقلنا: كلّم رسول اللّٰه ﷺ. فلما رأى رسول اللّٰه ﷺ ذلك قام خطيباً فقال: (( ما إكثارهم عليّ في حد من حدود الله عز وجل وقع على أمة من إماء الله! والذي نفسي بيده لو كانت فاطمة ابنة رسول الله ﷺ نزلت بالذي نزلت به لقطع محمد يدها )).
حسن: رواه ابن ماجه (٢٥٤٨) والحاكم (٤/٣٧٩-٣٨٠).

6980 — Muhammad ibn Talhah ibn Rukanah narrated from his mother Aishah bint Mas‘ud ibn al-Aswad, from her father, who said: When that woman stole the velvet cloth from the house of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we considered the matter grave. She was a woman from Quraysh, so we came to the Prophet ﷺ to speak to him and said: “We will ransom her with forty uqiyyahs.” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Her purification is better for her.”
When we heard the gentleness in the speech of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we went to Usamah and said: “Speak to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.” When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw that, he stood and delivered a sermon, saying: “Why do they repeatedly speak to me concerning one of the limits set by Allah, applied to one of Allah’s female servants? By the One in whose hand is my soul, if Fatimah the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had done what this woman did, Muhammad would cut off her hand.”
Hasan: Narrated by Ibn Majah (2548) and al-Hakim (4/379–380).

In another wording: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to cut off the hand of the thief for a quarter of a dinar or more.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6789) and Muslim (1684). The first wording is from al-Bukhari, and the second wording is from Muslim.

٦٩٨٣ — عن عائشة زوج النبي ﷺ قالت: سمعت رسول اللّٰه ﷺ يقول: (( اقطعوا في ربع دينار، ولا تقطعوا فيما هو أدنى من ذلك )).
وكان ربع الدينار يومئذ ثلاثة دراهم، والدينار اثني عشر درهماً. قال: وكانت سرقته دون ربع دينار، فلم أقطعه.
حسن: رواه الإمام أحمد (٢٤٥١٥).

6983 — Aishah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Cut off the hand for a quarter dinar, and do not cut it off for anything less than that.”
At that time, a quarter dinar was equal to three dirhams, and a dinar was twelve dirhams. He said: “His theft was less than a quarter dinar, so I did not cut off his hand.”
Hasan: Narrated by Imam Ahmad (24515).

٦٩٨٦ — عن ابن عمر أن النبي ﷺ قطع يد رجل سرق تُرساً من صُفّة النساء، ثمنه ثلاثة دراهم.
صحيح: رواه أحمد (٦٣١٧) وأبو داود (٤٣٨٦) والنسائي (٤٩٠٩).
قوله: (( صُفّة النساء )) هكذا في المصادر السابقة، وفي نسخة للنسائي: (( صنعة النساء )) والظاهر من قوله: (( من صُفَّة النساء )) أن جزءاً من الصفة كان مخصوصاً للنساء المهاجرات. فلعل قوله: (( صنعة النساء )) في إحدى نسخ النسائي تحريف.

6986 — Ibn Umar reported that the Prophet ﷺ cut off the hand of a man who stole a shield from the women’s shelter area, and its value was three dirhams.
 Sahih: Narrated by Ahmad (6317), Abu Dawud (4386), and al-Nasa’i (4909).
The phrase: “the women’s shelter area” appears this way in the previous sources, while in one version of al-Nasa’i it appears as: “the women’s quarters.” What is apparent from the wording “from the women’s shelter area” is that a part of the sheltered area was designated for the emigrant women. Therefore, the wording “the women’s quarters” in one manuscript of al-Nasa’i is likely a textual alteration.
