قوله: (( صُفّة النساء )) هكذا في المصادر السابقة، وفي نسخة للنسائي: (( صنعة النساء )) والظاهر من قوله: (( من صُفَّة النساء )) أن جزءاً من الصفة كان مخصوصاً للنساء المهاجرات. فلعل قوله: (( صنعة النساء )) في إحدى نسخ النسائي تحريف.
6986 — Ibn Umar reported that the Prophet ﷺ cut off the hand of a man who stole a shield from the women’s shelter area, and its value was three dirhams.
 Sahih: Narrated by Ahmad (6317), Abu Dawud (4386), and al-Nasa’i (4909).
The phrase: “the women’s shelter area” appears this way in the previous sources, while in one version of al-Nasa’i it appears as: “the women’s quarters.” What is apparent from the wording “from the women’s shelter area” is that a part of the sheltered area was designated for the emigrant women. Therefore, the wording “the women’s quarters” in one manuscript of al-Nasa’i is likely a textual alteration.

٦٩٨٨ — عن عبد اللّٰه بن عمرو بن العاص، عن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ أنه سئل عن الثمر المعلق فقال:
(( من أصاب بفيه من ذي حاجة غير متخذ خُبنة فلا شيء عليه، ومن خرج بشيء منه، فعليه غرامة مثليه والعقوبة، ومن سرق منه شيئاً بعد أن يؤويه الجرين فبلغ ثمن المجن فعليه القطع )).
وذكر في ضالة الإبل والغنم كما ذكره غيره.
قال: وسئل عن اللقطة فقال:
 (( ما كان منها في طريق الميتاء، أو القرية الجامعة فعرّفها سنة، فإن جاء طالبها فادفعها إليه، وإن لم يأت فهي لك. وما كان في الخراب يعني ففيها وفي الركاز الخمس )).
حسن: رواه أبو داود (١٧١٠) والترمذي (١٢٨٨) والنسائي (٤٩٥٨). واللفظ لأبي داود.

6988 — Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-‘As reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about hanging fruit, and he said:
 “Whoever eats from it out of need without taking any away in his garment has committed no offense. But whoever carries some away, then upon him is double compensation and punishment. And whoever steals from it after it has been gathered into the storage place, and it reaches the value of a shield, then cutting of the hand applies.”
He also mentioned the rulings regarding stray camels and sheep as mentioned elsewhere.
He said: The Prophet ﷺ was also asked about lost property, and he said:
 “If it is found on a commonly traveled road or in an inhabited village, announce it for one year. If its owner comes, give it to him; otherwise it belongs to you. But what is found in ruins, or buried treasure, then one-fifth is due from it.”
Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (1710), al-Tirmidhi (1288), and al-Nasa’i (4958). The wording is from Abu Dawud.

٦٩٩١ — عن أنس أن النبي ﷺ قال: (( ليس على منتهب، ولا مختلس، ولا خائن قطع )).
صحيح: رواه الطبراني في الأوسط (مجمع البحرين ٢٤٦٦).
والخلسة: ما يؤخذ سلباً ومكابرة. والخائن: هو من يأخذ المال بالغش والخيانة، ويظهر النصح للمالك.
 يقول الخطابي: “أجمع عامة أهل العلم على أن المختلس والخائن لا يُقطعان، وذلك أن اللّٰه سبحانه وتعالى إنما أوجب القطع على السارق.”

6991 — Anas reported that the Prophet ﷺ said:
 “There is no cutting of the hand for the plunderer, the snatcher, or the betrayer.”
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Tabarani in al-Awsat (Majma‘ al-Bahrayn 2466).
“Snatching” refers to property taken openly and forcefully.
 The “betrayer” is one who takes wealth through deception and betrayal while outwardly appearing sincere to the owner.
Al-Khattabi said: “The majority of the scholars agreed that the snatcher and betrayer do not have their hands cut off, because Allah only made cutting obligatory for the thief.”

 Sahih: Narrated by al-Tabarani in al-Awsat (Majma‘ al-Bahrayn 2466).
“Snatching” refers to property taken openly and forcefully.
 The “betrayer” is one who takes wealth through deception and betrayal while outwardly appearing sincere to the owner.
Al-Khattabi said: “The majority of the scholars agreed that the snatcher and betrayer do not have their hands cut off, because Allah only made cutting obligatory for the thief.”

٦٩٩٢ — عن صفوان بن أمية بن خلف أنه قيل له: هلك من لم يهاجر. قال: فقلت: لا أصل إلى أهلي حتى آتي رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فركبت راحلتي، فأتيت رسول اللّٰه ﷺ. فقلت: يا رسول الله ﷺ، زعموا أنه هلك من لم يهاجر؟ قال: (( كلا أبا وهب، فارجع إلى أباطح مكة )) قال: فبينما أنا راقد إذ جاء السارق، فأخذ ثوبي من تحت رأسي، فأدركته. فأتيت به النبي ﷺ. فقلت: إن هذا سرق ثوبي. فأمر به ﷺ أن يقطع. قال: قلت: يا رسول الله ﷺ، ليس هذا أردت. هو عليه صدقة. قال: (( فهلا قبل أن تأتيني به؟ ))
صحيح: رواه مالك (٣١) وأحمد (١٥٣٠٣) واللفظ له، وأبو داود (٤٣٩٤) والنسائي (٤٨٨١).
قال الخطابي: “واحتج من رأى أن المتاع المسروق لا قطع فيه إذا ملكه السارق قبل أن يرفع إلى الإمام بقوله: (( فهلا كان هذا قبل أن تأتيني به )) قالوا: فقد دل هذا على أنه لو وهبه منه، أو أبرأه من ذلك قبل أن يرفعه إلى الإمام سقط عنه القطع”.

6992 — Safwan ibn Umayyah ibn Khalaf reported that it was said to him: “Whoever did not migrate has perished.” He said: “So I said: I will not return to my family until I go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.” So I rode my mount and came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, they claim that whoever did not migrate has perished.” He said:
 “No, O Abu Wahb. Return to the valleys of Makkah.”
He said: While I was sleeping, a thief came and took my cloak from beneath my head. I caught him and brought him to the Prophet ﷺ. I said: “This man stole my cloak.” So the Prophet ﷺ ordered that his hand be cut off. I said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that is not what I intended. It is charity from me to him.” He said:
 “Why did you not do that before bringing him to me?”
 Sahih: Narrated by Malik (31), Ahmad (15303) — and this is his wording — Abu Dawud (4394), and al-Nasa’i (4881).
Al-Khattabi said: “Those who held that there is no cutting of the hand if the stolen item becomes the property of the thief before the case is raised to the ruler used as evidence the statement: ‘Why did you not do that before bringing him to me?’ They said: This indicates that if the owner had gifted it to him or pardoned him before bringing the matter to the ruler, the punishment of cutting would be dropped.”

٦٩٩٣ — عن ابن عمر قال: سمعت رسول اللّٰه ﷺ يقول: (( من حالت شفاعته دون حد من حدود اللّٰه عز وجل فقد ضاد اللّٰه أمره)).
صحيح: رواه أبو داود (٣٥٩٧) وأحمد (٥٣٨٥) وصحّحه الحاكم (٢٧/٢) والبيهقي (٨٢/٦).
وهذا بعد أن بلغ ذلك الإمام، فأما قبل بلوغ الإمام فإن الشفاعة فيها مستحبة حفظاً للستر عليه.
 قال أحمد: يُشفع في الحد ما لم يبلغ السلطان.

6993 — Ibn Umar said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
 “Whoever intercedes to prevent one of the prescribed punishments of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has opposed the command of Allah.”
 Sahih: Narrated by Abu Dawud (3597), Ahmad (5385), and authenticated by al-Hakim (2/27) and al-Bayhaqi (6/82).
This applies after the matter has reached the ruler. Before it reaches the ruler, intercession is recommended in order to preserve concealment.
 Ahmad said: “Intercession regarding prescribed punishments is allowed so long as it has not reached the authority.”

6994 — Amr ibn Shu‘ayb, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Amr, reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
 “Pardon the prescribed punishments among yourselves, but whatever reaches me of a prescribed punishment has become obligatory.”
 Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4376), al-Bayhaqi (8/331), and al-Nasa’i (4886), and authenticated by al-Hakim (4/383).

٦٩٩٦ — عن عائشة، أن النبي ﷺ قطع يد امرأة، قالت عائشة: وكانت تأتي بعد ذلك فأرفع حاجتها إلى النبي ﷺ فتابت وحسنت توبتها.

٦٩٩٧ — عن جنادة بن أبي أمية، قال: كنا مع بُسْر بن أبي أرطاة في البحر، فأُتي بسارق قد سرق بُختية. فقال: قد سمعت رسول اللّٰه ﷺ يقول: (( لا تُقطع الأيدي في السفر )) ولولا ذلك لقطعته.
صحيح: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٠٨) والنسائي (٤٩٧٩) والبيهقي (١٠٤/٩).
والمراد بالسفر هنا هو الغزو كما جاء في الروايات عند الترمذي (١٤٥٠).
 وقوله: (( بُختية )) الأنثى من الجمال البُخت.

6997 — Junadah ibn Abi Umayyah said: We were with Busr ibn Abi Artat at sea when a thief who had stolen a Bukhtiyyah camel was brought to him. He said: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
 ‘Hands are not cut off during travel.’
 Had it not been for that, I would have cut it off.”
 Sahih: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4408), al-Nasa’i (4979), and al-Bayhaqi (9/104).
What is intended by “travel” here is military expedition, as mentioned in the narrations of al-Tirmidhi (1450).
 “Bukhtiyyah” refers to a female camel of the Bukht breed.

٦٩٩٨ — عن أبي ذر قال: قال لي رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( كيف أنت إذا أصاب الناس موت، يكون البيت فيه بالوصيف؟ )) — يعني القبر — قلت: اللّٰه ورسوله أعلم، أو ما خار اللّٰه لي ورسوله. قال: (( عليك بالصبر )) أو قال: (( تصبر )).
صحيح: أخرجه أبو داود (٤٢٦١،٤٤٠٩) والحاكم (٤٢٤/٤) والبيهقي (١٩١/٨).
والبيت هنا: القبر. والوصيف: الخادم.

6998 — Abu Dharr reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me:
 “What will you do when death spreads among the people until a grave will cost the value of a servant?” — meaning the grave.
 I said: “Allah and His Messenger know best,” or “Whatever Allah and His Messenger choose.”
 He said:
 “Remain patient,” or he said: “Be patient.”
 Sahih: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4261, 4409), al-Hakim (4/424), and al-Bayhaqi (8/191).
The word “house” here refers to the grave, and “wasif” means a servant.

٦٩٩٩ — عن أبي هريرة قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( إذا سرق العبد فبيعوه ولو بنش )).
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٤١٢) والنسائي (٤٩٨٠) وابن ماجه (٢٥٨٩) والبخاري في الأدب المفرد (١٦٥).
وقوله: (( نش )) هو نصف كل شيء، ولو بنصف القيمة.

6999 — Abu Hurairah reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
 “If the slave steals, then sell him even for a Nish.”
 Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4412), al-Nasa’i (4980), Ibn Majah (2589), and al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad (165).
“Nish” means half of something, even if sold for half of his value.

٧٠٠٠ — عن عبد الله بن عمر قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ في حجة الوداع:
(( ألا أي شهر تعلمونه أعظم حرمة؟ )) قالوا: ألا شهرنا هذا. قال: (( ألا أي بلد تعلمونه أعظم حرمة؟ )) قالوا: ألا بلدنا هذا. قال: (( ألا أي يوم تعلمونه أعظم حرمة؟ )) قالوا: ألا يومنا هذا.
 قال: (( فإن اللّٰه تبارك وتعالى قد حرّم عليكم دماءكم وأموالكم وأعراضكم - إلا بحقها - كحرمة يومكم هذا في بلدكم هذا في شهركم هذا، ألا هل بلغت؟ )) (ثلاثاً) كل ذلك يجيبونه: ألا نعم. قال:
 (( ويحكم أو ويلكم لا ترجعن بعدي كفاراً يضرب بعضكم رقاب بعض ))
 متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٧٨٥) ومسلم (٦٦).

english_source:
7000 — Abdullah ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said in the Farewell Pilgrimage:
 “Do you know which month is most sacred?” They said: “This month of ours.” He said: “Do you know which land is most sacred?” They said: “This land of ours.” He said: “Do you know which day is most sacred?” They said: “This day of ours.”
 He then said:
 “Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has made your blood, your wealth, and your honor sacred to one another—except by right—just as sacred as this day of yours, in this land of yours, in this month of yours. Have I conveyed?” (three times) and they replied: “Yes.”
 He said:
 “Woe to you—do not revert after me to disbelief, striking the necks of one another.”
 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6785) and Muslim (66).

 “Do you know which month is most sacred?” They said: “This month of ours.” He said: “Do you know which land is most sacred?” They said: “This land of ours.” He said: “Do you know which day is most sacred?” They said: “This day of ours.”
 He then said:
 “Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has made your blood, your wealth, and your honor sacred to one another—except by right—just as sacred as this day of yours, in this land of yours, in this month of yours. Have I conveyed?” (three times) and they replied: “Yes.”
 He said:
 “Woe to you—do not revert after me to disbelief, striking the necks of one another.”
 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6785) and Muslim (66).

 “Avoid the seven destructive sins.” They asked: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, what are they?” He said:
 “Associating partners with Allah, magic, killing a soul whom Allah has forbidden except by right, consuming usury, consuming the wealth of an orphan, fleeing from the battlefield, and slandering chaste believing women who are unaware of evil.”

٧٠٠٢ — عن ابن عباس: أن هلال بن أمية قذف امرأته عند النبي ﷺ بشريك بن سحماء، فقال النبي ﷺ:
(( البينة أو حد في ظهرك )) فقال: يا رسول الله ﷺ، إذا رأى أحدنا على امرأته رجلاً ينطلق يلتمس البينة؟! فجعل يقول: (( البينة وإلا حد في ظهرك )) فذكر حديث اللعان.
 صحيح: رواه البخاري (٢٦٧١).

7002 — Ibn Abbas reported that Hilal ibn Umayyah accused his wife before the Prophet ﷺ of [adultery] with Sharik ibn Sahma’. The Prophet ﷺ said:
 “Bring proof, otherwise the legal punishment will be upon your back.”
 He said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, if one of us sees a man with his wife, does he go searching for proof?”
 The Prophet ﷺ kept saying: “Proof, or the legal punishment upon your back,” until the incident of mutual imprecation (li‘an) was revealed.
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Bukhari (2671).

٧٠٠٣ — عن عائشة قالت: لما نزل عذري قام رسول اللّٰه ﷺ على المنبر فذكر ذلك وتلا القرآن. فلما نزل من المنبر أمر برجلين وامرأة فضربوا حدهم.
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٧٤) والترمذي (٣١٨١) وحسنه، وابن ماجه (٢٥٦٧) وأحمد (٢٤٠٦٦).

 Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4474), al-Tirmidhi (3181), Ibn Majah (2567), and Ahmad (24066).

٧٠٠٥ — عن جابر بن عبد الله، أن رجلا قدم من جيشان (وجيشان من اليمن) فسأل النبي ﷺ عن شراب يشربونه بأرضهم من الذرة يقال له المزر؟ فقال النبي ﷺ: (( أو مسكر هو؟ )) قال: نعم. قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( كل مسكر حرام، إن على اللّٰه عز وجل عهدا لمن يشرب المسكر أن يسقيه من طينة الخبال)) قالوا: يا رسول الله ﷺ، وما طينة الخبال؟ قال: (( عرق أهل النار أو عصارة أهل النار)).
 صحيح: رواه مسلم (٢٠٠٢).

7005 — Jabir ibn Abdullah reported that a man came from Jayshan — a region in Yemen — and asked the Prophet ﷺ about a drink made from corn in their land called al-Mizr. The Prophet ﷺ said:
 “Is it intoxicating?”
 He replied: “Yes.”
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
 “Every intoxicant is forbidden. Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has made a covenant that whoever drinks intoxicants will be given to drink from the mud of al-Khabal.”
 They asked: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, what is the mud of al-Khabal?”
 He said:
 “The sweat of the people of Hell, or the discharge of the people of Hell.”
 Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (2002).

٧٠٠٦ — عن عبداللّٰه بن عمرو قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
 (( من شرب الخمر وسكر لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين صباحا، وإن مات دخل النار، فإن تاب تاب اللّٰه عليه. وإن عاد فشرب فسكر لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين صباحا، فإن مات دخل النار، فإن تاب تاب اللّٰه عليه. وإن عاد فشرب فسكر لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين صباحا، فإن مات دخل النار، فإن تاب تاب اللّٰه عليه. وإن عاد كان حقا على اللّٰه أن يسقيه من ردغة الخبال يوم القيامة ))
 قالوا: يا رسول الله ﷺ، وما ردغة الخبال؟ قال:
 (( عصارة أهل النار )).
 صحيح: رواه ابن ماجه (٣٣٧٧) وصحّحه ابن حبان (٥٣٥٧).

7006 — Abdullah ibn Amr reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
 “Whoever drinks intoxicants and becomes drunk, his prayer will not be accepted for forty mornings. If he dies, he enters the Fire. But if he repents, Allah accepts his repentance. If he returns and drinks again until intoxicated, his prayer will not be accepted for forty mornings. If he dies, he enters the Fire. But if he repents, Allah accepts his repentance. If he returns again and drinks until intoxicated, his prayer will not be accepted for forty mornings. If he dies, he enters the Fire. But if he repents, Allah accepts his repentance. Then if he returns again, it becomes a right upon Allah to give him to drink from Radghat al-Khabal on the Day of Resurrection.”
 They asked: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, what is Radghat al-Khabal?”
 He said:
 “The discharge of the people of Hell.”
 Sahih: Narrated by Ibn Majah (3377), and authenticated by Ibn Hibban (5357).

٧٠٠٦ — عن عبداللّٰه بن عمرو قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
 (( من شرب الخمر وسكر لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين صباحا، وإن مات دخل النار، فإن تاب تاب اللّٰه عليه. وإن عاد فشرب فسكر لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين صباحا، فإن مات دخل النار، فإن تاب تاب اللّٰه عليه. وإن عاد فشرب فسكر لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين صباحا، فإن مات دخل النار، فإن تاب تاب اللّٰه عليه. وإن عاد كان حقا على اللّٰه أن يسقيه من ردغة الخبال يوم القيامة ))
 قالوا: يا رسول الله ﷺ، وما ردغة الخبال؟ قال:
 (( عصارة أهل النار )).
 صحيح: رواه ابن ماجه (٣٣٧٧) وصحّحه ابن حبان (٥٣٥٧).

٧٠٠٧ — عن أنس، أن النبي ﷺ أتي برجل قد شرب الخمر، فجلده بجريدتين نحو أربعين. قال: وفعله أبو بكر، فلما كان عمر استشار الناس. فقال عبد الرحمن: أخفّ الحدود ثمانين، فأمر به عمر.
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٧٧٣) ومسلم (٣٥:١٧٠٦)، واللفظ لمسلم.

7007 — Anas reported that the Prophet ﷺ was brought a man who had drunk intoxicants, so he lashed him with two palm branches about forty times. He said: Abu Bakr did the same. Then when Umar became caliph, he consulted the people. Abd al-Rahman said: “The lightest prescribed punishment is eighty.” So Umar ordered eighty lashes.
 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6773) and Muslim (1706/35). The wording is from Muslim.

٧٠٠٨ — عن أنس بن مالك: أن نبي اللّٰه ﷺ جلد في الخمر بالجريد والنعال، ثم جلد أبو بكر أربعين، فلما كان عمر، ودنا الناس من الريف والقرى قال: ما ترون في جلد الخمر؟ فقال عبدالرحمن بن عوف: أرى أن تجعلها كأخف الحدود، قال: فجلد عمر ثمانين.
صحيح: رواه مسلم في الحدود (٣٦:١٧٠٦).

7008 — Anas ibn Malik reported that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ punished for drinking intoxicants with palm branches and sandals. Abu Bakr then lashed forty times. When Umar became caliph and people drew near from the villages and countryside, he said: “What do you think regarding the punishment for drinking intoxicants?” Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf said: “I think you should make it like the lightest prescribed punishment.” So Umar lashed eighty times.
 Sahih: Narrated by Muslim in al-Hudud (1706/36).

٧٠٠٩ — عن عروة بن الزبير أن عبيد اللّٰه بن عدي بن الخيار أخبره أن المسور بن مخرمة وعبد الرحمن بن الأسود بن عبد يغوث قالا له: ما يمنعك أن تكلم خالك عثمان في أخيه الوليد بن عقبة، وكان أكثر الناس فيما فعل به، قال عبيد الله: فانتصبت لعثمان حين خرج إلى الصلاة فقلت له: إن لي إليك حاجة وهي نصيحة فقال: أيها المرء أعوذ بالله منك فانصرفت، فلما قضيت الصلاة، جلست إلى المسور وإلى ابن عبد يغوث فحدثتهما بالذي قلت لعثمان وقال لي، فقالا: قد قضيت الذي كان عليك، فبينما أنا جالس معهما إذ جاءني رسول عثمان، فقالا لي: قد ابتلاك الله. فانطلقتُ حتى دخلت عليه فقال: ما نصيحتك التي ذكرت آنفا. قال: فتشهدت ثم قلت: إن اللّٰه بعث محمدا ﷺ وأنزل عليه الكتاب، وكنتَ ممن استجاب لله ورسوله ﷺ وآمنتَ به وهاجرتَ الهجرتين الأوليين وصحبتَ رسول اللّٰه ﷺ ورأيتَ هديه، وقد أكثر الناس في شأن الوليد بن عقبة، فحق عليك أن تقيم عليه الحد.
فقال لي: يا ابن أخي أدركت رسول اللّٰه ﷺ؟ قال: قلت: لا، ولكن قد خلص إلي من علمه ما خلص إلى العذراء في سترها. قال: فتشهد عثمان فقال: إن اللّٰه قد بعث محمدا ﷺ بالحق وأنزل عليه الكتاب وكنتُ ممن استجاب لله ورسوله وآمنت بما بعث به محمد وهاجرتُ الهجرتين الأوليين كما قلتَ، وصحبتُ رسول اللّٰه ﷺ وبايعته، والله ما عصيته، ولا غششته حتى توفاه الله، ثم استخلف الله أبا بكر، فوالله ما عصيته ولا غششته، ثم استخلف عمر، فوالله ما عصيته ولا غششته، ثم استخلفت، أفليس لي عليكم مثل الذي كان لهم علي؟ قال: بلى. قال: فما هذه الأحاديث التي تبلغني عنكم؟ فأما ما ذكرت من شأن الوليد بن عقبة فسنأخذ فيه إن شاء اللّٰه بالحق.
 قال: فجلد الوليدَ أربعين جلدةً، وأمر علياً أن يجلده، وكان هو يجلده.
 صحيح: رواه البخاري (٣٨٧٢) و(٣٦٩٦).

7009 — Urwah ibn al-Zubayr reported that Ubayd Allah ibn Adi ibn al-Khiyar informed him that al-Miswar ibn Makhramah and Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad ibn Abd Yaghuth said to him: “What prevents you from speaking to your uncle Uthman regarding his brother al-Walid ibn Uqbah? The people have spoken much about what he did.”
Ubayd Allah said: I stood before Uthman as he came out for prayer and said to him: “I have advice for you.” He replied: “O man, I seek refuge in Allah from you.” So I left. After the prayer I sat with al-Miswar and Ibn Abd Yaghuth and informed them of what had happened. They said: “You have fulfilled your duty.”
While I was sitting with them, a messenger from Uthman came to me. They said: “Allah has now tested you.” So I went to him and entered upon him. He said: “What was the advice you mentioned earlier?” I testified and then said: “Allah sent Muhammad ﷺ with the truth and revealed the Book to him. You were among those who responded to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, believed in him, made both migrations, accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and saw his guidance. The people have spoken much regarding al-Walid ibn Uqbah, and it is your duty to establish the punishment upon him.”
Uthman said to me: “My nephew, did you meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?” I replied: “No, but knowledge of him has reached me just as clearly as it reaches a virgin in her chamber.”
Then Uthman testified and said: “Allah indeed sent Muhammad ﷺ with the truth and revealed the Book to him. I was among those who responded to Allah and His Messenger, believed in what Muhammad was sent with, made both migrations as you mentioned, accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and pledged allegiance to him. By Allah, I never disobeyed or deceived him until Allah took him. Then Allah appointed Abu Bakr as caliph, and by Allah I never disobeyed or deceived him. Then Umar was appointed, and by Allah I never disobeyed or deceived him. Then I was appointed. Do I not deserve from you the same rights they had over me?” They said: “Yes.” He said: “Then what are these reports that reach me from you? As for what you mentioned regarding al-Walid ibn Uqbah, we shall deal with him according to the truth, if Allah wills.”
He then lashed al-Walid forty lashes and ordered Ali to carry out the lashing, and Ali himself administered it.
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Bukhari (3872) and (3696).

٧٠٠٩ — عن عروة بن الزبير أن عبيد اللّٰه بن عدي بن الخيار أخبره أن المسور بن مخرمة وعبد الرحمن بن الأسود بن عبد يغوث قالا له: ما يمنعك أن تكلم خالك عثمان في أخيه الوليد بن عقبة، وكان أكثر الناس فيما فعل به، قال عبيد الله: فانتصبت لعثمان حين خرج إلى الصلاة فقلت له: إن لي إليك حاجة وهي نصيحة فقال: أيها المرء أعوذ بالله منك فانصرفت، فلما قضيت الصلاة، جلست إلى المسور وإلى ابن عبد يغوث فحدثتهما بالذي قلت لعثمان وقال لي، فقالا: قد قضيت الذي كان عليك، فبينما أنا جالس معهما إذ جاءني رسول عثمان، فقالا لي: قد ابتلاك الله. فانطلقتُ حتى دخلت عليه فقال: ما نصيحتك التي ذكرت آنفا. قال: فتشهدت ثم قلت: إن اللّٰه بعث محمدا ﷺ وأنزل عليه الكتاب، وكنتَ ممن استجاب لله ورسوله ﷺ وآمنتَ به وهاجرتَ الهجرتين الأوليين وصحبتَ رسول اللّٰه ﷺ ورأيتَ هديه، وقد أكثر الناس في شأن الوليد بن عقبة، فحق عليك أن تقيم عليه الحد.
فقال لي: يا ابن أخي أدركت رسول اللّٰه ﷺ؟ قال: قلت: لا، ولكن قد خلص إلي من علمه ما خلص إلى العذراء في سترها. قال: فتشهد عثمان فقال: إن اللّٰه قد بعث محمدا ﷺ بالحق وأنزل عليه الكتاب وكنتُ ممن استجاب لله ورسوله وآمنت بما بعث به محمد وهاجرتُ الهجرتين الأوليين كما قلتَ، وصحبتُ رسول اللّٰه ﷺ وبايعته، والله ما عصيته، ولا غششته حتى توفاه الله، ثم استخلف الله أبا بكر، فوالله ما عصيته ولا غششته، ثم استخلف عمر، فوالله ما عصيته ولا غششته، ثم استخلفت، أفليس لي عليكم مثل الذي كان لهم علي؟ قال: بلى. قال: فما هذه الأحاديث التي تبلغني عنكم؟ فأما ما ذكرت من شأن الوليد بن عقبة فسنأخذ فيه إن شاء اللّٰه بالحق.
 قال: فجلد الوليدَ أربعين جلدةً، وأمر علياً أن يجلده، وكان هو يجلده.
 صحيح: رواه البخاري (٣٨٧٢) و(٣٦٩٦).
7009 — Urwah ibn al-Zubayr reported that Ubayd Allah ibn Adi ibn al-Khiyar informed him that al-Miswar ibn Makhramah and Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad ibn Abd Yaghuth said to him: “What prevents you from speaking to your uncle Uthman regarding his brother al-Walid ibn Uqbah? The people have spoken much about what he did.”
Ubayd Allah said: I stood before Uthman as he came out for prayer and said to him: “I have advice for you.” He replied: “O man, I seek refuge in Allah from you.” So I left. After the prayer I sat with al-Miswar and Ibn Abd Yaghuth and informed them of what had happened. They said: “You have fulfilled your duty.”
While I was sitting with them, a messenger from Uthman came to me. They said: “Allah has now tested you.” So I went to him and entered upon him. He said: “What was the advice you mentioned earlier?” I testified and then said: “Allah sent Muhammad ﷺ with the truth and revealed the Book to him. You were among those who responded to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, believed in him, made both migrations, accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and saw his guidance. The people have spoken much regarding al-Walid ibn Uqbah, and it is your duty to establish the punishment upon him.”
Uthman said to me: “My nephew, did you meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?” I replied: “No, but knowledge of him has reached me just as clearly as it reaches a virgin in her chamber.”
Then Uthman testified and said: “Allah indeed sent Muhammad ﷺ with the truth and revealed the Book to him. I was among those who responded to Allah and His Messenger, believed in what Muhammad was sent with, made both migrations as you mentioned, accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and pledged allegiance to him. By Allah, I never disobeyed or deceived him until Allah took him. Then Allah appointed Abu Bakr as caliph, and by Allah I never disobeyed or deceived him. Then Umar was appointed, and by Allah I never disobeyed or deceived him. Then I was appointed. Do I not deserve from you the same rights they had over me?” They said: “Yes.” He said: “As for what you mentioned regarding al-Walid ibn Uqbah, we shall deal with him according to the truth, if Allah wills.”
He then lashed al-Walid forty lashes and ordered Ali to carry out the lashing, and Ali himself administered it.

٧٠١٠ — عن حصين بن المنذر أبي ساسان قال: شهدت عثمان بن عفان وأُتي بالوليد، قد صلّى الصّبح ركعتين. ثم قال: أزيدكم؟ فشهد عليه رجلان: أحدهما حمران أنه شرب الخمر. وشهد آخر أنه رآه يتقيّأ. فقال عثمان: إنه لم يتقيّأ حتى شربها. فقال: يا علي، قمْ فاجْلده، فقال علي: قم يا حسن فاجلده، فقال الحسن: ولّ حارّها من تولّى قارّها - فكأنه وجد عليه - فقال: يا عبد اللّٰه بن جعفر، قم فاجلده، فجلده وعليّ يعدّ، حتى بلغ أربعين. فقال: أمسك. ثم قال: جلد النبي ﷺ أربعين، وجلد أبو بكر أربعين، وعمر ثمانين. كل سنة وهذا أحب إليّ.
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٧٠٧).
وقوله: (( ولّ حارها من تولى قارها )) مثل أي ولّ العقوبة والضرب من تولّى العمل والنفع. والقار: البارد.

english_source:
7010 — Husayn ibn al-Mundhir Abu Sasan said: I witnessed Uthman ibn Affan when al-Walid was brought to him after having led the dawn prayer in two rak‘ahs and then said: “Shall I give you more?” Two men testified against him: one of them was Humran, who testified that he had drunk intoxicants, and another testified that he saw him vomiting. Uthman said: “He would not vomit unless he had drunk it.”
Then he said: “O Ali, stand and lash him.” Ali said: “O Hasan, stand and lash him.” Hasan replied: “Let the one who enjoyed its coolness handle its heat,” as though he was upset with him. Then Ali said: “O Abdullah ibn Ja‘far, stand and lash him.” So he lashed him while Ali counted until he reached forty. Then he said: “Stop.”
Ali then said: “The Prophet ﷺ lashed forty, Abu Bakr lashed forty, and Umar lashed eighty. All are Sunnah, but this is more beloved to me.”
 Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (1707).
The phrase “Let the one who enjoyed its coolness handle its heat” is a proverb meaning: let the one who took responsibility for the benefit also bear the burden of punishment. “Coolness” refers to ease and comfort.

٧٠١١ — عن علي بن أبي طالب قال: ما كنت لأقيم حدّاً على أحد فيموت فأجد في نفسي، إلا صاحب الخمر فإنه لو مات وديتُه، وذلك أن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ لم يسنّه.
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٧٧٨) ومسلم (٣٩:١٧٠٧).
قوله: (( لأن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ لم يسنّه )) أي لم يقدر فيه حدّاً مقدراً.

7011 — Ali ibn Abi Talib said: “I would not carry out a prescribed punishment on anyone and then feel regret if he died, except in the case of the drinker of intoxicants. If he died, I would pay blood money for him, because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not specify a fixed punishment for it.”
 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6778) and Muslim (1707/39).
The statement “the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not specify it” means that he did not set a fixed prescribed number for the punishment.

قوله: (( لأن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ لم يسنّه )) أي لم يقدر فيه حدّاً مقدراً.
7011 — Ali ibn Abi Talib said: “I would not carry out a prescribed punishment on anyone and then feel regret if he died, except in the case of the drinker of intoxicants. If he died, I would pay blood money for him, because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not specify a fixed punishment for it.”
 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6778) and Muslim (1707/39).
The statement “the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not specify it” means that he did not set a fixed prescribed number for the punishment.

arabic_source:
٧٠١٢ — عن عبد الرحمن بن أزهر قال: أتي النبي ﷺ بشارب وهو بحنين، فحثا وجهه في التراب، ثم أمر أصحابه فضربوه بالنعال، وما كان في أيديهم. حتى قال لهم: (( ارفعوا)) فرفعوا. فتوفي رسول اللّه ﷺ ثم جلد أبو بكر في الخمر أربعين، ثم جلد عمر أربعين صدراً من إمارته، ثم جلد ثمانين في آخر خلافته، ثم جلد عثمان الحدين كليهما: ثمانين وأربعين. ثم أثبت معاوية الحد ثمانين.
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٨٨) والنسائي في الكبرى (٥٢٨٣).

english_source:
7012 — Abd al-Rahman ibn Azhar said: The Prophet ﷺ was brought a man who had drunk intoxicants during the battle of Hunayn. He threw dust in his face, then ordered his companions to strike him with sandals and whatever was in their hands, until he said to them: “Stop,” so they stopped.
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away. Abu Bakr lashed forty times for drinking intoxicants. Umar lashed forty during the early part of his caliphate, then eighty during the latter part of it. Uthman applied both punishments: eighty and forty. Then Mu‘awiyah established the punishment as eighty lashes.
 Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4488) and al-Nasa’i in al-Kubra (5283).

arabic_source:
٧٠١٣ — عن أبي هريرة قال: أُتي النبي ﷺ برجل قد شرب، قال: اضربوه. قال أبو هريرة: فمنا الضارب بيده، والضارب بنعله، والضارب بثوبه. فلما انصرف قال بعض القوم: أخزاك الله. قال: لا تقولوا هكذا، لا تعينوا عليه الشيطان.
صحيح: رواه البخاري (٦٧٧٧).

english_source:
7013 — Abu Hurayrah said: A man who had drunk intoxicants was brought to the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: “Strike him.” Abu Hurayrah said: Some of us struck him with their hands, some with their sandals, and some with their garments. When he left, some of the people said: “May Allah disgrace you.” The Prophet ﷺ said: “Do not say that. Do not help Satan against him.”
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6777).

٧٠١٤ — عن السائب بن يزيد قال: كنا نؤتى بالشارب على عهد رسول اللّٰه ﷺ وإمرة أبي بكر، وصدراً من خلافة عمر، فنقوم إليه بأيدينا ونعالنا وأرديتنا، حتى كان آخر إمرة عمر فجلد أربعين حتى إذا عتوا وفسقوا جلد ثمانين.
صحيح: رواه البخاري (٦٧٧٩).

english_source:
7014 — Al-Sa’ib ibn Yazid said: During the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the caliphate of Abu Bakr, and the early part of Umar’s caliphate, when a drinker was brought to us, we would strike him with our hands, sandals, and cloaks. Then toward the end of Umar’s rule, he lashed forty times, and when people became excessive and immoral, he lashed eighty times.
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6779).

٧٠١٥ — عن معاوية قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( من شرب الخمر فاجلدوه، فإن عاد في الرابعة فاقتلوه )) .
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٤٨٢) والترمذي (١٤٤٤) وابن ماجه (٢٥٧٣) وأحمد (١٦٨٥٩).

7015 — Mu‘awiyah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever drinks intoxicants, lash him. If he returns a fourth time, then kill him.”
 Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4482), al-Tirmidhi (1444), Ibn Majah (2573), and Ahmad (16859).

7016 — Abu Hurayrah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If he becomes intoxicated, lash him. Then if he becomes intoxicated again, lash him. Then if he becomes intoxicated again, lash him. If he returns a fourth time, then kill him.”
 Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4484), al-Nasa’i (5662), Ibn Majah (2572), and Ahmad (7911).

 Hasan: Narrated by Imam Ahmad (18053), al-Tabarani in al-Kabir (1/198 and 7/366), and al-Hakim (4/373).

٧٠١٧ — عن شرحبيل بن أوس - وكان من أصحاب النبي ﷺ - أنه قال: قال النبي ﷺ: (( من شرب الخمر فاجلدوه، فإن عاد فاجلدوه، فإن عاد فاجلدوه، فإن عاد فاقتلوه )).
حسن: رواه الإمام أحمد (١٨٠٥٣) والطبراني في الكبير (١٩٨/١) و(٣٦٦/٧) والحاكم (٣٧٣/٤).
7017 — Sharhabil ibn Aws — who was among the companions of the Prophet ﷺ — reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever drinks intoxicants, lash him. If he returns, lash him. If he returns again, lash him. If he returns again, then kill him.”
 Hasan: Narrated by Imam Ahmad (18053), al-Tabarani in al-Kabir (1/198 and 7/366), and al-Hakim (4/373).

٧٠١٩ — عن ديلم الحِمْيَري أنه سأل رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فقال: إنا بأرض باردة، وإنا لنستعين بشراب يُصنع لنا من القمح. فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( أَيُسْكِرُ؟ )) قال: نعم. قال: (( فلا تشربوه )) فأعاد عليه فقال له رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( أَيُسْكِرُ؟ )) قال: نعم، قال: (( فلا تشربوه )) فأعاد عليه الثالثة. فقال له رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( أيُسكر؟ )) قال: نعم، قال: (( فلا تشربوه )) قال: فإنهم لا يصبرون عنه. قال: (( فإن لم يصبروا عنه فاقتلوهم)).
صحيح: رواه أحمد (١٨٠٣٤) والطبراني في الكبير (٢٦٩/٤).

7019 — Daylam al-Himyari asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, saying: “We live in a cold land and use a drink made from wheat.” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Does it intoxicate?” He replied: “Yes.” He said: “Then do not drink it.”
He repeated the question, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ again said: “Does it intoxicate?” He said: “Yes.” He replied: “Then do not drink it.”
He repeated it a third time, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked: “Does it intoxicate?” He said: “Yes.” He replied: “Then do not drink it.”
He said: “They cannot do without it.” The Prophet ﷺ said: “If they cannot refrain from it, then kill them.”
 Sahih: Narrated by Ahmad (18034) and al-Tabarani in al-Kabir (4/269).

٧٠٢١ — عن عمر بن الخطاب أن رجلاً كان على عهد النبي ﷺ كان اسمه عبد الله، وكان يُلقّب حماراً، وكان يُضحك رسول اللّٰه ﷺ وكان النبي ﷺ قد جلده في الشراب، فأُتي به يوماً فأمر به فجلد، فقال رجل من القوم: اللهم العنْه، ما أكثر ما يُؤتى به! فقال النبي ﷺ: (( لا تلعنوه، فواللّٰه ما علمتُ أنه يحبّ اللّٰه ورسوله )).
صحيح: رواه البخاري (٦٧٨٠).

english_source:
7021 — Umar ibn al-Khattab reported that during the lifetime of the Prophet ﷺ there was a man named Abdullah who was nicknamed “Himar,” and he used to make the Messenger of Allah ﷺ laugh. The Prophet ﷺ had previously punished him for drinking intoxicants. One day he was brought again, and the Prophet ﷺ ordered that he be flogged. A man among the people said: “O Allah, curse him! How often he is brought for this!” The Prophet ﷺ said: “Do not curse him, for by Allah, I know nothing about him except that he loves Allah and His Messenger.”
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6780).

7022 — Jabir ibn Abdullah reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: “If someone drinks intoxicants, lash him. If he returns, lash him. If he returns again, lash him. If he returns a fourth time, kill him.” Then a man from among us was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but he did not kill him.
 Hasan: Narrated by Ibn Hazm in al-Muhalla (11/368) and al-Tahawi in Sharh Ma‘ani al-Athar (4836).

٧٠٢٣ — عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ الحارِثِ قَالَ: جِيءَ بِالنَّعَيْمانِ أَوْ ابْنِ النُّعَيْمانِ شَارِباً، فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللّٰه ﷺ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الْبَيْتِ أَنْ يَضْرِبُوا، قَالَ: فَكُنْتُ أَنَا فِيمَنْ ضَرَبَهُ، فَضَرَبْنَاهُ بِالنِّعَالِ وَالجرِيدِ.
صحيح: رواه البخاري (٦٧٧٥، ٦٧٧٤، ٢٣١٦).

7023 — Uqbah ibn al-Harith said: Al-Nu‘ayman, or Ibn al-Nu‘ayman, was brought having drunk intoxicants, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered those in the house to strike him. Uqbah said: “I was among those who struck him, and we struck him with sandals and palm branches.”
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6775, 6774, 2316).

٧٠٢٤ — عن أبي بردة الأنصاري قال: سمعت النبي ﷺ يقول: (( لا تجلدوا فوق عشرة أسواط إلا في حد من حدود اللّٰه )). وفي لفظ: (( لا يُجلد فوق عشرة جلدات إلا في حدّ من حدود اللّٰه )).
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٨٥٠) ومسلم (١٧٠٨). واللفظ للبخاري.

7024 — Abu Burdah al-Ansari said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Do not lash more than ten lashes except in one of the prescribed punishments set by Allah.”
 In another wording: “No one is to be lashed more than ten times except in a prescribed punishment from the punishments of Allah.”
 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6850) and Muslim (1708). The wording is that of al-Bukhari.

متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٨٤٩) ومسلم (٤٠/١٧٠٨).

 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6849) and Muslim (1708/40).

٧٠٢٦ — عن ابن عمر أنهم كانوا يُضربون على عهد النبي ﷺ إذا اشتروا طعاماً جزافاً أن يبيعوه مكانهم حتى يُؤووه إلى رحالهم.
صحيح: رواه البخاري (٦٨٥٢).

7026 — Ibn Umar reported that during the time of the Prophet ﷺ, people would be disciplined if they bought food in bulk and sold it in the same place before moving it to their own dwellings.
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6852).

arabic_source:
٧٠٢٧ — عن أم المؤمنين عائشة أنها قالت: ما خُيّر رسول اللّٰه ﷺ بين أمرين إلا أخذ أيسرهما ما لم يكن إثماً. فإن كان إثماً كان أبعد الناس منه. وما انتقم رسول اللّٰه ﷺ لنفسه إلا أن تُنتهك حُرمة اللّٰه عز وجل.
متفق عليه: رواه مالك (٢) والبخاري (٣٥٦٠) ومسلم (٢٣٢٧).

7027 — The Mother of the Believers, Aishah, said: Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was given a choice between two matters, he would choose the easier of the two so long as it was not sinful. But if it was sinful, he was the farthest of people from it. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never took revenge for himself unless the sacred limits of Allah were violated.
 Agreed upon: Narrated by Malik (2), al-Bukhari (3560), and Muslim (2327).
